stem: A company is implementing a new network architecture and needs to consider the requirements and considerations for training and inference. Which of the following statements is true about training and inference architecture?
explanation:
C 最合适：训练通常关注完成模型训练所需的时间，交互式推理则需要满足响应时间目标；两者都需要足够的吞吐量以及合适的硬件和软件。
C is the best fit: training often targets time to a trained model, while interactive inference must meet a response-time target. Both still need sufficient throughput and suitable hardware and software.

options.text: Training architecture and inference architecture have the same requirements and considerations.
options.translationZh: 训练架构与推理架构的要求和考虑因素完全相同。

options.text: Training architecture is only concerned with hardware requirements, while inference architecture is only concerned with software requirements.
options.translationZh: 训练架构只关注硬件要求，推理架构只关注软件要求。

options.text: Training architecture is focused on optimizing performance while inference architecture is focused on reducing latency.
options.translationZh: 训练架构侧重优化性能，推理架构侧重降低延迟。

options.text: Training architecture and inference architecture cannot be the same.
options.translationZh: 训练架构与推理架构不可能相同。

sources.title: NVIDIA: training and inference
sources.supports: Training adjusts model weights; inference uses learned weights to process new inputs.

sources.title: Triton Model Analyzer: online and offline modes
sources.supports: Online inference can optimize throughput subject to a latency budget; offline inference can optimize throughput without a real-time constraint.

outline:
先区分构建模型与提供预测服务。
Distinguish model building from serving predictions.

比较典型优化重点，而不是把资源需求割裂开。
Compare typical optimization priorities, not exclusive resource requirements.

排除“只关注”或“绝不可能相同”等绝对表述。
Reject absolute claims such as only or cannot.
analysis.whyChoose:
C 最合适：训练通常关注完成模型训练所需的时间，交互式推理则需要满足响应时间目标；两者都需要足够的吞吐量以及合适的硬件和软件。
C is the best fit: training often targets time to a trained model, while interactive inference must meet a response-time target. Both still need sufficient throughput and suitable hardware and software.

whyNotChoose.text: Training architecture and inference architecture have the same requirements and considerations.
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：即使共用基础设施，长时间训练任务与交互式预测服务也可能有不同的延迟、可用性和扩展目标。
Incorrect: a long-running training job and an interactive prediction service can have different latency, availability and scaling targets even on shared infrastructure.

whyNotChoose.text: Training architecture is only concerned with hardware requirements, while inference architecture is only concerned with software requirements.
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：训练除了硬件还需要框架和分布式软件；推理同样需要计算、内存与网络资源。
Incorrect: training needs frameworks and distributed software as well as hardware; inference also needs compute, memory and networking.

whyNotChoose.text: Training architecture and inference architecture cannot be the same.
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：同一批 GPU 服务器或集群可以支持两个阶段。针对工作负载进行调优，不意味着必须采用物理上分离的架构。
Incorrect: the same GPU servers or cluster can support both stages. Workload-specific tuning does not require physically separate architectures.

stem: For which workloads is NVIDIA Merlin typically used?
explanation:
选 A：Merlin 面向推荐系统，例如为用户召回候选内容并排序。
Choose A: Merlin is designed for recommender systems, such as retrieving and ranking items for a user.

options.translationZh: 推荐系统。

options.text: Natural language processing
options.translationZh: 自然语言处理。

options.text: Data analytics
options.translationZh: 数据分析。

sources.title: NVIDIA Merlin: recommender workflows
sources.supports: Merlin targets recommender pipelines, including preprocessing, feature engineering, training and inference.

outline:
识别产品的目标应用：个性化推荐。
Identify the product’s target application: personalized recommendations.

把目标应用与支撑它的数据处理环节区分开。

stem: Which NVIDIA parallel computing platform and programming model allows developers to program in popular languages and express parallelism through extensions?
explanation:
选 A：CUDA 是底层并行平台与编程模型；cuML 和 cuGraph 是位于其上的专用库。
Choose A: CUDA is the underlying parallel platform and programming model; cuML and cuGraph are specialized libraries built above that layer.

options.text: CUDA
options.translationZh: CUDA 并行计算平台。

options.text: CUML
options.translationZh: cuML 机器学习库。

options.text: CUGRAPH
options.translationZh: cuGraph 图分析库。

sources.title: CUDA Programming Guide: GPU and CPU design goals
sources.supports: CUDA enables general-purpose GPU computing. GPU design favors many parallel threads and high aggregate throughput; CPUs favor fast individual threads and also execute threads in parallel.

sources.title: CUDA Programming Guide
sources.supports: CUDA is a parallel computing platform and programming model with language extensions including C++ and Python.

sources.title: RAPIDS / CUDA-X data science API documentation
sources.supports: cuML implements machine-learning algorithms, cuDF handles data frames, and cuGraph provides graph analytics.

outline:
抓住“平台”和“编程模型”这两个关键词。
Notice the paired terms platform and programming model.

排除面向特定算法类别的库。
Eliminate libraries named for a specific class of algorithms.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 A：CUDA 是底层并行平台与编程模型；cuML 和 cuGraph 是位于其上的专用库。
Choose A: CUDA is the underlying parallel platform and programming model; cuML and cuGraph are specialized libraries built above that layer.

whyNotChoose.text: CUML
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：cuML 提供机器学习算法，利用 GPU 平台运行，而不是取代 CUDA 的通用编程模型。
Incorrect: cuML supplies machine-learning algorithms. It uses the GPU platform rather than replacing CUDA’s general programming model.

whyNotChoose.text: CUGRAPH
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：cuGraph 面向关系与连通性等图处理工作负载，不是通用 GPU 语言扩展平台。
Incorrect: cuGraph focuses on graph-processing workloads such as relationships and connectivity, not general GPU language extensions.

stem: Which of the following aspects have led to an increase in the adoption of AI? (Choose two.)
explanation:
选 C、D：强大的并行算力使更大的模型具备可行性，丰富的数据则为模型提供学习样本。
Choose C and D: powerful parallel compute makes larger models practical, and abundant data provides examples from which they can learn.

analysis.whyChoose:

whyNotChoose.text: Moore’s Law.
whyNotChoose.reason:
不属于题目预期的两项：半导体规模增长在历史上促进了计算发展，但这一经验规律不如实际可用的并行加速器与数据集直接。
Not one of the intended pair: semiconductor scaling helped computing historically, but this observation is less direct than the available parallel accelerators and datasets.

whyNotChoose.text: Rule-based machine learning.
whyNotChoose.reason:

stem: In training and inference architecture requirements, what is the main difference between training and inference?
explanation:
B 是题目预期的对比：大型训练任务使用数据集，在线推理需要及时响应。根本区别是学习参数与使用已学模型，而不是数据量或是否实时。
B is the intended comparison: large training jobs consume datasets, while online inference must respond promptly. The fundamental distinction is learning parameters versus using the learned model.

stem: Which of the following statements is true about GPUs and CPUs?
explanation:
选 A：GPU 偏重大量线程的总吞吐量；CPU 偏重单线程快速执行与灵活的控制流。
Choose A: GPUs favor aggregate throughput across many threads; CPUs favor fast execution of individual threads and flexible control flow.

options.text: GPUs are optimized for parallel tasks, while CPUs are optimized for serial tasks.
options.translationZh: GPU 针对并行任务优化，而 CPU 针对串行任务优化。

options.text: GPUs have very low bandwidth main memory while CPUs have very high bandwidth main memory.
options.translationZh: GPU 的主存带宽很低，而 CPU 的主存带宽很高。

options.text: GPUs and CPUs have the same number of cores, but GPUs have higher clock speeds.
options.translationZh: GPU 与 CPU 的核心数量相同，但 GPU 的时钟频率更高。

options.text: GPUs and CPUs have identical architectures and can be used interchangeably.
options.translationZh: GPU 与 CPU 的架构相同，可以互换使用。

sources.title: CUDA Programming Guide: GPU and CPU design goals
sources.supports: CUDA enables general-purpose GPU computing. GPU design favors many parallel threads and high aggregate throughput; CPUs favor fast individual threads and also execute threads in parallel.

outline:
比较设计目标，而不是只看一个主频数字。
Compare design goals rather than a single clock-speed number.

排除架构相同或核心数量固定相等的说法。
Reject claims of identical architecture or fixed equal core counts.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 A：GPU 偏重大量线程的总吞吐量；CPU 偏重单线程快速执行与灵活的控制流。
Choose A: GPUs favor aggregate throughput across many threads; CPUs favor fast execution of individual threads and flexible control flow.

whyNotChoose.text: GPUs have very low bandwidth main memory while CPUs have very high bandwidth main memory.
whyNotChoose.reason:
作为一般比较不正确：GPU 通常用高设备内存带宽支撑大量运算单元。主机到设备的连接带宽是另一个指标。
Incorrect as a general comparison: GPUs commonly provide high device-memory bandwidth to feed many arithmetic units. Host-to-device link bandwidth is a different measurement.

whyNotChoose.text: GPUs and CPUs have the same number of cores, but GPUs have higher clock speeds.
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：核心数量相同、GPU 主频更高都不是通则；CPU 核心与 GPU 执行单元也不能直接等同。
Incorrect: neither equal core counts nor higher GPU clock rates is a general rule. A CPU core and a GPU execution unit are also not directly equivalent.

whyNotChoose.text: GPUs and CPUs have identical architectures and can be used interchangeably.
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：不同的执行与存储设计需要相应的软件和工作负载映射。GPU 不能取代 CPU 的所有职责。
Incorrect: different execution and memory designs require suitable software and workload mapping. A GPU does not replace every CPU responsibility.

learning.speedTipHtml:
GPU：大量相似操作一起算；CPU：单个线程执行快、控制灵活。
GPU: many similar operations together. CPU: fast, flexible individual threads.
studyNotesHtml:
CPU 也通过多核和向量指令实现并行。GPU 是否加速取决于工作负载与数据搬运成本。
CPUs also support parallelism through multiple cores and vector instructions. GPU acceleration depends on the workload and data-movement cost.

originalExplanation: GPUs consist of many simpler cores designed for massive parallelism (e.g., thousands of threads), whereas CPUs use a few powerful cores optimized for sequential and branching workloads.

aiStudy.stemZh: 关于 GPU 与 CPU，下列哪项描述最合适？

sources.title: CUDA Programming Guide: GPU and CPU design goals
sources.supports: CUDA enables general-purpose GPU computing. GPU design favors many parallel threads and high aggregate throughput; CPUs favor fast individual threads and also execute threads in parallel.

aiStudy.reviewNote: Retained A as a comparison of design priorities, not a claim that CPUs cannot parallelize. Core counts, clock rates and memory bandwidth depend on the actual products.

summary.en: Choose A: GPUs favor aggregate throughput across many threads; CPUs favor fast execution of individual threads and flexible control flow.
summary.zh: 选 A：GPU 偏重大量线程的总吞吐量；CPU 偏重单线程快速执行与灵活的控制流。

memory.en: GPU: many similar operations together. CPU: fast, flexible individual threads.
memory.zh: GPU：大量相似操作一起算；CPU：单个线程执行快、控制灵活。

pitfall.en: CPUs also support parallelism through multiple cores and vector instructions. GPU acceleration depends on the workload and data-movement cost.
pitfall.zh: CPU 也通过多核和向量指令实现并行。GPU 是否加速取决于工作负载与数据搬运成本。

steps.en: Compare design goals rather than a single clock-speed number.
steps.zh: 比较设计目标，而不是只看一个主频数字。

steps.en: Reject claims of identical architecture or fixed equal core counts.
steps.zh: 排除架构相同或核心数量固定相等的说法。

A.zh: GPU 针对并行任务优化，而 CPU 针对串行任务优化。

reason.en: Best answer as a design comparison. Read optimized for as a preference, not a ban on CPU parallel execution or GPU sequential dependencies.
reason.zh: 作为设计取向对比，这是最佳答案。“针对……优化”表示侧重点，并非否认 CPU 并行执行或 GPU 中的顺序依赖。

B.zh: GPU 的主存带宽很低，而 CPU 的主存带宽很高。

reason.en: Incorrect as a general comparison: GPUs commonly provide high device-memory bandwidth to feed many arithmetic units. Host-to-device link bandwidth is a different measurement.
reason.zh: 作为一般比较不正确：GPU 通常用高设备内存带宽支撑大量运算单元。主机到设备的连接带宽是另一个指标。

C.zh: GPU 与 CPU 的核心数量相同，但 GPU 的时钟频率更高。

reason.en: Incorrect: neither equal core counts nor higher GPU clock rates is a general rule. A CPU core and a GPU execution unit are also not directly equivalent.
reason.zh: 错误：核心数量相同、GPU 主频更高都不是通则；CPU 核心与 GPU 执行单元也不能直接等同。

D.zh: GPU 与 CPU 的架构相同，可以互换使用。

reason.en: Incorrect: different execution and memory designs require suitable software and workload mapping. A GPU does not replace every CPU responsibility.
reason.zh: 错误：不同的执行与存储设计需要相应的软件和工作负载映射。GPU 不能取代 CPU 的所有职责。

stem: Which phase of deep learning benefits the greatest from a multi-node architecture?
explanation:

whyNotChoose.text: Data Augmentation
whyNotChoose.reason:

stem: Which architecture is the core concept behind large language models?
explanation:
选 C：Transformer 是许多主流大语言模型所用的架构名称。注意力是其中的关键机制；BERT Large 是具体模型。
Choose C: Transformer names the architecture used by many mainstream LLMs. Attention is a key mechanism within it; BERT Large is a specific model.

Too specific: BERT Large is one Transformer-based model configuration, not the general architecture behind the broader model class.

whyNotChoose.text: State space model
whyNotChoose.reason:
不是本题预期的主流答案，但在技术上属于有效的替代架构系列。Mamba 等模型说明语言建模并非必须使用 Transformer。
Not the intended mainstream answer, but technically a valid alternative family. Models such as Mamba show that language modeling need not use Transformers.

Less precise: attention describes a mechanism for relating representations. Naming that mechanism alone does not identify the full Transformer architecture.

summary.en: Choose C: Transformer names the architecture used by many mainstream LLMs. Attention is a key mechanism within it; BERT Large is a specific model.

outline:

选择其基础发行版，而不是其他受支持平台。

whyNotChoose.text: Red Hat
whyNotChoose.reason:
对于 DGX OS 不正确：NVIDIA 生态中其他位置对企业 Linux 的支持，与本产品基于哪个发行版是不同问题。

stem: Which type of GPU core was specifically designed to realistically simulate the lighting of a scene?
explanation:
选 C：RT Core 加速确定光线与场景几何体的交点，这是逼真光线追踪照明的重要环节。
Choose C: RT Cores accelerate finding where rays intersect scene geometry, a key part of realistic ray-traced lighting.

options.text: Tensor Cores
options.translationZh: Tensor Core 张量核心。

options.text: CUDA Cores
options.translationZh: CUDA Core 计算核心。

options.text: Ray Tracing Cores
options.translationZh: Ray Tracing Core 光线追踪核心。

sources.title: NVIDIA Turing architecture: RT and Tensor Cores
sources.supports: RT Cores accelerate BVH traversal and ray intersection tests; shader execution remains on SMs. Tensor Cores accelerate matrix operations.

outline:
识别专用光线追踪操作，而不是泛指图形能力。
Identify the specialized ray-tracing operation, not general graphics capability.

把求交与遍历工作对应到 RT 硬件。
Match intersection and traversal work to RT hardware.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 C：RT Core 加速确定光线与场景几何体的交点，这是逼真光线追踪照明的重要环节。
Choose C: RT Cores accelerate finding where rays intersect scene geometry, a key part of realistic ray-traced lighting.

whyNotChoose.text: Tensor Cores
whyNotChoose.reason:
不符合所问的专用功能：Tensor Core 加速矩阵运算。AI 重建可以改善渲染图像，但并不是光线求交硬件。
Incorrect for the named specialization: Tensor Cores accelerate matrix operations. AI reconstruction may improve a rendered image, but it is not ray-intersection hardware.

whyNotChoose.text: CUDA Cores
whyNotChoose.reason:
不是专用硬件答案：可编程 GPU 算术可以支持着色和软件光线追踪，但 RT Core 专门卸载遍历与求交工作。
Not the specialized answer: programmable GPU arithmetic can support shading and software ray tracing, but RT Cores specifically offload traversal and intersection work.

stem: When should RoCE be considered to enhance network performance in a multi-node AI computing environment?
explanation:
如果 CPU 网络处理开销导致链路利用不足，选 C：支持 RDMA 的适配器可以把传输与数据放置工作从 CPU 软件路径中卸载出去。
Choose C when CPU networking overhead prevents link utilization: RDMA-capable adapters can move transport and data-placement work out of the CPU software path.

options.text: A network that experiences a high packet loss rate (PLR).
options.translationZh: 网络存在较高的丢包率。

options.text: A network with large amounts of storage traffic.
options.translationZh: 网络存在大量存储流量。

options.text: A network that cannot utilize the full available bandwidth due to high CPU utilization.
options.translationZh: 由于 CPU 利用率过高，网络无法充分利用可用带宽。

sources.title: NVIDIA Dynamo: RDMA overview
sources.supports: RDMA-capable adapters transfer data directly between memories; RoCE carries RDMA over Ethernet.

sources.title: RoCE in the Data Center
sources.supports: Explains hardware transport offload, OS bypass and reduced CPU copying overhead. Used for architecture, not its historical speed figures.

outline:
确认是否是传输处理占用了 CPU。
Identify whether transport processing consumes the CPU.

评估支持 RDMA 的硬件与软件，不要假定换一种协议就能解决所有吞吐问题。
Evaluate RDMA-capable hardware and software rather than assuming a protocol change fixes every throughput problem.

Not the right diagnosis: investigate congestion, errors and network configuration. RoCE is not a generic packet-loss repair mechanism.

whyNotChoose.reason:
可能是适用场景，但条件不充分：流量大不证明 CPU 协议处理就是瓶颈，也不证明存储栈支持 RDMA。
Possible use case, but insufficient by itself: large traffic volumes do not prove CPU protocol processing is the limiting factor or that the storage stack supports RDMA.

stem: An IT Professional is considering whether to implement an on-prem or cloud infrastructure. Which of the following is a key advantage of on-prem infrastructure?
explanation:
按“直接控制数据位置、物理访问与安全运维”的含义选 C。本地部署不会自动使数据安全。
Choose C in the sense of direct control over data location, physical access and security operations. On-premises deployment does not automatically make data secure.

options.text: Lower upfront costs and capital expenditure
options.translationZh: 更低的前期成本与资本支出。

options.text: Scalability and flexibility
options.translationZh: 可扩展性与灵活性。

options.text: Ensure data security and sovereignty
options.translationZh: 确保数据安全与数据主权。

options.text: Easy remote management.
options.translationZh: 容易进行远程管理。

sources.title: AWS: cloud versus on premises
sources.supports: On-premises ownership provides direct control and entails capital investment and maintenance; cloud access reduces upfront infrastructure acquisition.

outline:
把所有权与控制能力作为区别。
Identify ownership and control as the distinguishing benefit.

不要把控制能力误当成安全保证或更低的初始成本。
Do not confuse control with a security guarantee or lower initial cost.

按“直接控制数据位置、物理访问与安全运维”的含义选 C。本地部署不会自动使数据安全。

whyNotChoose.reason:

Usually not the advantage: buying and installing infrastructure requires upfront resources; cloud services commonly lower that initial acquisition barrier.

whyNotChoose.text: Scalability and flexibility
whyNotChoose.reason:

Not the strongest differentiator: local systems can scale, but additional hardware may require procurement and installation, while cloud capacity is often provisioned on demand.

whyNotChoose.reason:

stem: Which feature of RDMA reduces CPU utilization and lowers latency?
explanation:
选 B：支持 RDMA 的适配器通过硬件处理传输与直接内存放置，减少主机软件工作。
Choose B: an RDMA-capable adapter handles transport and direct memory placement in hardware, reducing host software work.

options.text: Network adapters that include hardware offloading.

options.text: NVIDIA Magnum I/O software.

sources.supports: RDMA-capable adapters transfer data directly between memories; RoCE carries RDMA over Ethernet.

outline:
判断哪个组件执行实际传输。

explanation:

explanation:

选 A，1.2：它是这些选项中最小、最接近理想值 1.0 的比值。
Choose A, 1.2: it is the smallest ratio and closest to the ideal 1.0 among these choices.

options.text: PUE of 1.2
options.translationZh: PUE 为 1.2。

options.text: PUE of 3.5
options.translationZh: PUE 为 3.5。

options.text: PUE of 5.0
options.translationZh: PUE 为 5.0。

options.text: PUE of 2.0
options.translationZh: PUE 为 2.0。

sources.title: US Department of Energy: PUE definition
sources.supports: PUE is total facility energy divided by IT equipment energy; its theoretical minimum is one.

outline:
四个数都使用同一个分母：IT 能耗。
Apply the same denominator, IT energy, to all four values.

选择高于理想基准 1 且最小的数值。
Choose the lowest value above the ideal baseline of one.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 A，1.2：它是这些选项中最小、最接近理想值 1.0 的比值。
Choose A, 1.2: it is the smallest ratio and closest to the ideal 1.0 among these choices.

whyNotChoose.text: PUE of 3.5
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：每单位 IT 能耗对应 2.5 单位附加能耗，明显高于 PUE 1.2。
Incorrect: overhead is 2.5 units per IT unit, substantially higher than at PUE 1.2.

whyNotChoose.text: PUE of 5.0
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：每单位 IT 能耗对应 4 单位附加能耗，是列表中最大的附加能耗比。
Incorrect: overhead is 4 units per IT unit, the largest overhead ratio in the list.

whyNotChoose.text: PUE of 2.0
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：附加能耗等于 IT 能耗，总能耗为 IT 能耗的两倍，不如 A 的 1.2 比值。
Incorrect: overhead equals IT energy, giving twice the total energy per IT unit rather than the 1.2 ratio available in A.

选 A，1.2：它是这些选项中最小、最接近理想值 1.0 的比值。
Choose A, 1.2: it is the smallest ratio and closest to the ideal 1.0 among these choices.
learning.speedTipHtml:
PUE＝设施总能耗÷IT 能耗；越接近 1，设施附加能耗越少。
PUE = facility energy ÷ IT energy; closer to one means less facility overhead.
studyNotesHtml:
PUE 为 1.2 时，附加能耗是 IT 能耗的 20%，不是设施总能耗的 20%。仅凭低 PUE 不能证明 AI 计算本身高效。
At PUE 1.2, overhead is 20% of IT energy, not 20% of total facility energy. Low PUE alone does not prove efficient AI computation.

stem: Which solution should be recommended to support real-time collaboration and rendering among a team?
explanation:
选 C：合适的认证 RTX 服务器与交互可视化、渲染负载相匹配，还应配套所需的协作软件。
Choose C: a suitable certified RTX server aligns with interactive visualization and rendering, paired with the required collaboration software.

options.text: A cluster of servers with NVIDIA T4 GPUs in each server.
options.translationZh: 每台服务器都配有 NVIDIA T4 GPU 的服务器集群。

options.text: A DGX SuperPOD.
options.translationZh: DGX SuperPOD 集群。

options.text: An NVIDIA Certified Server with RTX based GPUs.
options.translationZh: 配有 RTX GPU 的 NVIDIA 认证服务器。

sources.title: NVIDIA-Certified Systems configuration guide
sources.supports: Certified configurations cover rendering, virtual workstations and Omniverse; hardware must be selected for the workload.

sources.title: NVIDIA RTX professional software certification
sources.supports: RTX professional GPUs target applications including design, visualization and rendering.

outline:
识别目标负载是渲染与交互协作。
Identify rendering and interactive collaboration as the target workload.

选择受支持的图形平台，而不是只追求服务器数量。
Choose a supported graphics platform rather than merely maximizing server count.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 C：合适的认证 RTX 服务器与交互可视化、渲染负载相匹配，还应配套所需的协作软件。
Choose C: a suitable certified RTX server aligns with interactive visualization and rendering, paired with the required collaboration software.

whyNotChoose.text: A cluster of servers with NVIDIA T4 GPUs in each server.
whyNotChoose.reason:
匹配不够直接：T4 可以服务多种负载，但一个未指定配置的 T4 集群，不能说明已经满足该交互场景所需的图形与应用配置。
Less directly matched: T4 can serve various workloads, but an unspecified T4 cluster does not establish the graphics and application configuration needed for this interactive use case.

whyNotChoose.text: A DGX SuperPOD.
whyNotChoose.reason:
不是针对性答案：SuperPOD 侧重大规模 AI 计算，其规模本身并不能提供交互式图形与协作方案。
Not the targeted answer: SuperPOD emphasizes large-scale AI computation. Its scale alone does not supply an interactive graphics and collaboration solution.

learning.stemHtml: Which solution should be recommended to support real-time collaboration and rendering among a team?要支持团队实时协作与渲染，应推荐下列哪种方案？

stem: What is a key benefit of using NVIDIA GPUDirect RDMA in an AI environment?
explanation:
选 B：在受支持的传输中，网卡到 GPU 内存的直接路径避免主机内存中转，减少拷贝开销并可能降低延迟。
Choose B: the NIC-to-GPU memory path avoids host-memory staging for supported transfers, reducing copying overhead and potentially latency.

options.text: It increases the power efficiency and thermal management of GPUs.
options.translationZh: 提高 GPU 的电源效率与散热管理能力。

options.text: It reduces the latency and bandwidth overhead of remote memory access between GPUs.
options.translationZh: 减少 GPU 之间远程内存访问的延迟与带宽开销。

options.text: It enables faster data transfers between GPUs and CPUs without involving the operating system.
options.translationZh: 无需操作系统参与，就能加速 GPU 与 CPU 之间的数据传输。

options.text: It allows multiple GPUs to share the same memory space without any synchronization.
options.translationZh: 允许多个 GPU 无需任何同步就共享同一内存空间。

sources.title: GPUDirect RDMA overview and memory ordering
sources.supports: Provides a direct GPU-to-peer-device data path and requires appropriate registration, synchronization and ordering.

sources.title: NVIDIA Dynamo RDMA setup
sources.supports: With GPUDirect RDMA, network adapters access GPU memory directly instead of staging transfers in host memory.

outline:
识别远程传输的数据路径，而不是电源管理。
Identify the remote-transfer data path rather than power management.

区分避免中转缓冲区与消除全部 CPU 协调。
Distinguish avoiding a bounce buffer from removing all CPU coordination.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 B：在受支持的传输中，网卡到 GPU 内存的直接路径避免主机内存中转，减少拷贝开销并可能降低延迟。
Choose B: the NIC-to-GPU memory path avoids host-memory staging for supported transfers, reducing copying overhead and potentially latency.

whyNotChoose.text: It increases the power efficiency and thermal management of GPUs.
whyNotChoose.reason:
范围不对：电源与散热策略不是这一直接内存传输功能的定义性用途。
Incorrect scope: power and thermal policies are not the function that defines this direct-memory transfer feature.

whyNotChoose.text: It enables faster data transfers between GPUs and CPUs without involving the operating system.
whyNotChoose.reason:
端点描述错误且过度概括：GPUDirect RDMA 面向网卡等对等设备访问 GPU 内存，不是普通 CPU–GPU 拷贝，也不是操作系统完全不参与。
Wrong endpoints and overstatement: GPUDirect RDMA concerns a peer device such as a NIC accessing GPU memory, not ordinary CPU-GPU copies with no operating-system role.

whyNotChoose.text: It allows multiple GPUs to share the same memory space without any synchronization.
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：内存注册、可见性与同步仍然重要；不同步的读写可能产生竞争。
Incorrect: memory registration, visibility and synchronization still matter; unsynchronized reads and writes can race.

stem: What is an advantage of InfiniBand over Ethernet?
explanation:
C 是预期答案：InfiniBand 面向低延迟通信设计。实际比较仍取决于适配器、交换机、软件与工作负载。
C is the intended answer: InfiniBand is designed for low-latency communication. Actual comparisons depend on adapters, switches, software and workload.

options.text: InfiniBand always provides higher bandwidth than Ethernet.
options.translationZh: InfiniBand 的带宽始终高于以太网。

options.text: InfiniBand supports RDMA while Ethernet does not.

options.text: InfiniBand offers lower latency than Ethernet.

sources.supports: InfiniBand targets low latency and high throughput with communication offload.

sources.title: NVIDIA Dynamo: RDMA fabric types
sources.supports: RDMA is available on both InfiniBand and Ethernet through RoCE.

outline:
排除跨未指定产品的“带宽始终更高”说法。
Reject always-higher-bandwidth claims across unspecified products.

记住 RoCE，不要把 RDMA 当成 InfiniBand 独有能力。
Remember RoCE before treating RDMA as exclusive to InfiniBand.

C is the intended answer: InfiniBand is designed for low-latency communication. Actual comparisons depend on adapters, switches, software and workload.

learning.stemHtml: What is an advantage of InfiniBand over Ethernet?与以太网相比，InfiniBand 的一项典型优势是什么？
learning.keyPointHtml:
C 是预期答案：InfiniBand 面向低延迟通信设计。实际比较仍取决于适配器、交换机、软件与工作负载。
C is the intended answer: InfiniBand is designed for low-latency communication. Actual comparisons depend on adapters, switches, software and workload.
learning.speedTipHtml:
InfiniBand 强调低延迟；以太网也能承载 RDMA。
InfiniBand emphasizes low latency; Ethernet can also carry RDMA.
studyNotesHtml:
不要推断所有 InfiniBand 链路都比所有以太网链路快；应比较指定代际与实测端到端延迟。
Never infer that all InfiniBand links are faster than all Ethernet links. Compare specified generations and measured end-to-end latency.

排除跨未指定产品的“带宽始终更高”说法。
Reject always-higher-bandwidth claims across unspecified products.

记住 RoCE，不要把 RDMA 当成 InfiniBand 独有能力。
Remember RoCE before treating RDMA as exclusive to InfiniBand.

options.explanation:
错误：支持的速率随代际与产品变化。仅凭技术名称无法支持“始终”这一断言。
Incorrect: supported rates vary by generation and product. The word always makes a claim the technology names cannot establish.
options.explanationHtml:

options.explanation:
错误：RoCE 明确提供以太网上的 RDMA，因此所谓独占性不成立。
Incorrect: RoCE explicitly provides RDMA over Ethernet, so the supposed exclusivity is false.
options.explanationHtml:
错误：RoCE 明确提供以太网上的 RDMA，因此所谓独占性不成立。
Incorrect: RoCE explicitly provides RDMA over Ethernet, so the supposed exclusivity is false.

options.explanation:
作为通常与传统网络的比较，这是最佳答案，但并非相对于所有加速以太网配置的无条件性能保证。
Best answer as the usual conventional-network comparison, but not an unconditional performance guarantee against every accelerated Ethernet configuration.

originalExplanation: InfiniBand’s streamlined protocol and hardware offloads deliver microsecond-class, low-latency communication that outperforms Ethernet’s higher round-trip delays.

stem: In a data center, what is the purpose and benefit of a DPU?
explanation:
选 D：DPU 把基础设施服务从主机应用 CPU 转移出去，提供可编程加速与隔离。
Choose D: a DPU moves infrastructure services away from the host application CPU and provides programmable acceleration and isolation.

options.text: A DPU is responsible for providing backup and disaster recovery solutions.
options.translationZh: DPU 负责提供备份与灾难恢复方案。

options.text: A DPU is used for managing physical infrastructure, such as power and cooling.
options.translationZh: DPU 用于管理供电与散热等物理基础设施。

options.text: A DPU is responsible for managing network connections and security.
options.translationZh: DPU 负责管理网络连接与安全。

options.text: A DPU is designed to offload, accelerate, and isolate infrastructure workloads.
options.translationZh: DPU 用于卸载、加速并隔离基础设施工作负载。

sources.title: NVIDIA BlueField: DPU definition
sources.supports: A programmable infrastructure processor can offload, accelerate and isolate networking, storage and security services from the host.

outline:
识别基础设施服务类别，包括网络、存储与安全。
Identify the infrastructure-service category, including networking, storage and security.

选择解释架构价值的答案，而不是只列出一个用途。
Choose the answer that explains the architectural benefit, not just one use case.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 D：DPU 把基础设施服务从主机应用 CPU 转移出去，提供可编程加速与隔离。
Choose D: a DPU moves infrastructure services away from the host application CPU and provides programmable acceleration and isolation.

whyNotChoose.text: A DPU is responsible for providing backup and disaster recovery solutions.
whyNotChoose.reason:
过窄且非定义性用途：DPU 可以辅助数据服务，但它主要不是完整的备份与灾难恢复产品。
Too narrow and not defining: a DPU may assist data services, but it is not primarily a complete backup and disaster-recovery product.

whyNotChoose.text: A DPU is used for managing physical infrastructure, such as power and cooling.
whyNotChoose.reason:
类别不对：设施供电与散热管理不是这里 DPU 所指的可编程网络、存储与安全服务角色。
Incorrect category: facility power and cooling management are not the programmable network, storage and security service role meant by DPU.

whyNotChoose.text: A DPU is responsible for managing network connections and security.
whyNotChoose.reason:
部分正确但不完整：这些确实是它可处理的服务示例。D 更完整地描述了卸载、加速与隔离的目的。
Partly true but incomplete: those are examples of services it can handle. D better captures the broader offload, acceleration and isolation purpose.

stem: Which of the following statements is true about Kubernetes orchestration?
explanation:
选 B、D：Kubernetes 把工作负载放到合适节点，并支持服务流量分发。它编排推理应用，而不是自身执行模型推理。
Select B and D: Kubernetes places workloads on suitable nodes and supports service traffic distribution. It orchestrates inference applications rather than performing model inference itself.

options.text: It is bare-metal based but it supports containers.
options.translationZh: 它以裸金属为基础，但支持容器。

options.text: It has advanced scheduling capabilities to assign jobs to available resources.
options.translationZh: 它具备调度能力，可把作业分配给可用资源。

options.text: It has no inferencing capabilities.
options.translationZh: 它不具备推理能力。

options.text: It does load balancing to distribute traffic across containers.
options.translationZh: 它通过负载均衡在容器之间分配流量。

sources.title: Kubernetes scheduler
sources.supports: The scheduler filters and scores nodes using resource requests and placement constraints.

sources.title: Kubernetes Services
sources.supports: Services expose backend endpoints; traffic distribution depends on the networking implementation and Service type, with headless Services as an exception.

sources.title: Kubernetes overview
sources.supports: Kubernetes orchestrates containerized workloads and can operate on physical or virtual infrastructure.

outline:
区分部署底座、调度、网络与推理执行。
Separate deployment substrate, scheduling, networking and inference execution.

选择两个受支持的编排功能。
Choose both supported orchestration functions.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 B、D：Kubernetes 把工作负载放到合适节点，并支持服务流量分发。它编排推理应用，而不是自身执行模型推理。
Select B and D: Kubernetes places workloads on suitable nodes and supports service traffic distribution. It orchestrates inference applications rather than performing model inference itself.

whyNotChoose.text: It is bare-metal based but it supports containers.
whyNotChoose.reason:
作为定义有误导性：Kubernetes 是容器编排系统，节点可以是物理机或虚拟机。裸金属只是可选部署方式，不是定义性限制。
Misleading as a definition: Kubernetes is a container orchestration system, and its nodes may be physical machines or VMs. Bare-metal deployment is one option, not its defining restriction.

whyNotChoose.text: It has no inferencing capabilities.
whyNotChoose.reason:
如果此句表示它不能支持推理负载，则错误：它能承载模型服务。Kubernetes 自身确实不是数值推理引擎，因此该选项措辞有歧义。
Incorrect if this means it cannot support inference workloads: it can host model servers. It is true that Kubernetes itself is not a numerical inference engine, so the option is ambiguously worded.

stem: In an AI cluster, what is the purpose job scheduling?
explanation:
选 C：调度器把工作负载需求与可用计算资源匹配，并决定何时可以运行。
Choose C: a scheduler matches workload requirements to available compute resources and decides when work can run.

options.text: To gather and analyze cluster data on a regular schedule.

stem: In an AI cluster, what is the importance of using Slurm?
explanation:

options.text: Slurm is used for interconnecting nodes in an AI cluster.
options.translationZh: Slurm 用于互连 AI 集群节点。

sources.supports: Slurm allocates resources, starts and monitors work, and manages contention through a pending-job queue and configurable scheduling policies.

outline:
按资源管理功能判断产品类别。
Classify the product by its resource-management function.

把它与数据、模型和物理网络层区分开。

analysis.whyChoose:

Choose D: Slurm is a workload manager that schedules jobs and allocates cluster resources.

whyNotChoose.text: Slurm is used for data storage and retrieval in an AI cluster.
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：Slurm 管理的作业可以访问存储，但实际存储与检索由应用和存储服务执行。
Incorrect: jobs may access storage while running under Slurm, but storage and retrieval are performed by their applications and storage services.

whyNotChoose.text: Slurm is responsible for AI model training and inference in an AI cluster.
whyNotChoose.reason:
过宽且有误导性：Slurm 协调执行，训练框架与模型服务器才实现训练和推理算法。
Too broad and misleading: Slurm coordinates execution; frameworks and model servers implement training and inference algorithms.

whyNotChoose.text: Slurm is used for interconnecting nodes in an AI cluster.
whyNotChoose.reason:
层次不对：适配器、链路与交换机连接节点。Slurm 可以考虑拓扑，但不提供物理互连。
Incorrect layer: adapters, links and switches interconnect nodes. Slurm can consider topology without supplying that physical fabric.

sources.supports: DCGM provides data-center GPU monitoring, health checks, diagnostics and management policies.

outline:

Identify the monitored resource: NVIDIA data-center GPUs.

匹配专门的管理套件。

whyNotChoose.text: NVIDIA System Monitor
whyNotChoose.reason:
不是这里指定的数据中心 GPU 套件。泛化的系统监视器名称，不能对应 DCGM 明确的健康检查与诊断功能。

stem: What is the primary command for checking the GPU utilization on a single DGX H100 system?
explanation:
选 A：nvidia-smi 是查询 GPU 状态与受支持利用率指标的 NVIDIA 命令行工具。
Choose A: nvidia-smi is the NVIDIA command-line utility for querying GPU status and supported utilization metrics.

options.text: nvidia-smi
options.translationZh: nvidia-smi 命令。

options.text: ctop
options.translationZh: ctop 容器指标工具。

options.text: nvml
options.translationZh: NVML 管理库。

sources.title: NVIDIA System Management Interface
sources.supports: nvidia-smi exposes GPU metrics and uses NVML. GPU utilization is sampled time with one or more kernels executing, distinct from memory capacity usage.

sources.title: ctop project
sources.supports: ctop is a top-like interface for container metrics, not NVIDIA’s GPU management command.

outline:
注意题目问的是命令。
Notice that the question asks for a command.

区分命令行工具、容器监视器与编程 API。
Distinguish the CLI from container monitors and programming APIs.

whyNotChoose.text: ctop
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：ctop 侧重容器资源指标，不是主要的 NVIDIA GPU 状态命令。
Incorrect: ctop focuses on container resource metrics; it is not the primary NVIDIA GPU status command.

whyNotChoose.reason:

stem: What is a common tool for container orchestration in AI clusters?
explanation:
选 A：在这些选项中，Kubernetes 是通用容器编排平台。
Choose A: Kubernetes is the general container orchestration platform among these choices.

options.text: Kubernetes
options.translationZh: Kubernetes 容器编排平台。

options.text: MLOps
options.translationZh: MLOps 机器学习运维实践。

options.text: Slurm
options.translationZh: Slurm 作业管理器。

options.text: Apptainer
options.translationZh: Apptainer 容器平台。

sources.title: Kubernetes overview
sources.supports: Kubernetes manages containerized workloads and services.

sources.title: Slurm overview
sources.supports: Slurm allocates resources, starts and monitors work, and manages contention through a pending-job queue and configurable scheduling policies.

sources.title: Apptainer introduction
sources.supports: Apptainer packages and runs portable applications on HPC systems and integrates with cluster resources.

outline:
识别跨节点与服务的编排需求。
Identify orchestration across nodes and services.

排除生命周期实践概念，以及侧重其他层次的工具。
Eliminate a lifecycle discipline and tools focused on different layers.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 A：在这些选项中，Kubernetes 是通用容器编排平台。
Choose A: Kubernetes is the general container orchestration platform among these choices.

whyNotChoose.text: MLOps
whyNotChoose.reason:
类别不对：MLOps 描述生命周期流程与实践，不是某一个具体编排程序或平台。
Incorrect category: MLOps describes lifecycle processes and practices, not one specific orchestration executable or platform.

whyNotChoose.text: Slurm
whyNotChoose.reason:
不是预期类别：Slurm 调度批处理或 HPC 负载，也可以启动容器，但不是这里所问的通用服务型容器编排器。
Not the intended category: Slurm schedules batch/HPC workloads and may launch containers, but is not the general service-oriented container orchestrator asked here.

whyNotChoose.text: Apptainer
whyNotChoose.reason:
层次不对：Apptainer 封装并执行容器，通常由调度器管理；它自身不提供 Kubernetes 式的集群编排角色。
Incorrect layer: Apptainer packages and executes containers, often under a scheduler; it does not itself provide the Kubernetes-style cluster orchestration role.

stem: When monitoring a GPU-based workload, what is GPU utilization?
explanation:
选 C：常用 GPU 利用率指标衡量采样区间内的活动时间，而不是已分配显存或可用核心数。
Choose C: the usual GPU-utilization metric measures active time during a sample interval, rather than allocated memory or available cores.

options.text: The maximum amount of time a GPU will be used for a workload.
options.translationZh: GPU 将被某个工作负载使用的最长时间。

options.text: The GPU memory in use compared to available GPU memory.
options.translationZh: 已用 GPU 显存与可用显存的比例。

options.text: The percentage of time the GPU is actively processing data.
options.translationZh: GPU 正在处理数据的时间百分比。

options.text: The number of GPU cores available to the workload.
options.translationZh: 工作负载可使用的 GPU 核心数量。

sources.title: NVIDIA System Management Interface
sources.supports: nvidia-smi exposes GPU metrics and uses NVML. GPU utilization is sampled time with one or more kernels executing, distinct from memory capacity usage.

outline:
识别指标的分子与采样区间。
Identify the metric’s numerator and sampling interval.

区分基于时间的活动、容量占用与执行效率。

whyNotChoose.reason:
指标不对：资源数量描述容量或分配额度，不表示采样区间内资源是否活跃。
Incorrect metric: resource count describes capacity or allocation, not whether it was active during the sample.

stem: What is the importance of a job scheduler in an AI resource-constrained cluster?
explanation:
选 D：调度器协调竞争中的作业，依据需求与策略分配有限资源。
Choose D: a scheduler coordinates competing jobs so that limited resources are assigned according to requirements and policy.

options.text: It allocates resources based on which job requests came first.
options.translationZh: 按作业请求的先来后到分配资源。

options.text: It ensures the all jobs in the cluster are executed simultaneously.
options.translationZh: 确保集群中的全部作业同时执行。

options.text: It increases the number of resources available in the cluster.
options.translationZh: 增加集群中可用资源的数量。

options.text: It allocates resources efficiently and optimizes job execution.
options.translationZh: 高效分配资源并优化作业执行。

sources.title: Slurm overview
sources.supports: Slurm allocates resources, starts and monitors work, and manages contention through a pending-job queue and configurable scheduling policies.

outline:
从有限资源与相互竞争的需求出发。
Start from finite resources and competing requirements.

选择协调分配，而不是保证同时执行所有作业。
Choose coordinated allocation rather than guaranteed simultaneous execution.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 D：调度器协调竞争中的作业，依据需求与策略分配有限资源。
Choose D: a scheduler coordinates competing jobs so that limited resources are assigned according to requirements and policy.

whyNotChoose.text: It allocates resources based on which job requests came first.
whyNotChoose.reason:
仅是一种可能策略：严格按到达顺序运行，不是调度器的通用行为或全部价值。
Only a possible policy: strict arrival ordering is not the universal behavior or full value of a scheduler.

whyNotChoose.text: It ensures the all jobs in the cluster are executed simultaneously.
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：资源有限时，作业往往需要排队；能否并行运行取决于可用容量与隔离需求。
Incorrect: limited resources often require jobs to queue; concurrent execution depends on available capacity and isolation requirements.

whyNotChoose.text: It increases the number of resources available in the cluster.
whyNotChoose.reason:
作为物理资源说法不正确：调度可更有效地使用现有容量，但自身不会新增硬件。
Incorrect as a physical claim: scheduling can use existing capacity more effectively but does not add hardware by itself.

stem: How is Out-of-band Management utilized by network operators in an AI environment?
explanation:
选 A：独立管理路径使设备访问与排错不必依赖正常的生产数据路径。
Choose A: a separate management path allows device access and troubleshooting without depending on the normal production-data path.

options.text: It used to remotely manage and troubleshoot network devices independently of the production network.
options.translationZh: 独立于生产网络，远程管理网络设备并排查故障。

options.text: It is used to directly manage the AI model’s learning rate during training sessions.
options.translationZh: 在训练期间直接管理 AI 模型的学习率。

options.text: It is used to increase the computational power of AI models by adapting additional processing resources.
options.translationZh: 通过增加处理资源，提高 AI 模型的计算能力。

options.text: It is used to manage the data throughput of AI applications by prioritizing network traffic.
options.translationZh: 通过优先安排网络流量，管理 AI 应用的数据吞吐量。

sources.supports: The OOB fabric connects device management ports separately from workload-facing networks.

outline:
识别通往管理接口的独立通道。

stem: What is the maximum number of MIG instances that an H100 GPU provides?
explanation:
选 A，七个：H100 最小的受支持 GPU 实例配置，允许最多同时创建七个实例。
Choose A, seven: the smallest supported H100 GPU-instance profiles permit up to seven simultaneous instances.

options.translationZh: 七个。
八个。
四个。

sources.title: NVIDIA supported MIG profiles
sources.supports: H100 profiles allow a maximum of seven 1g GPU instances; larger profiles allow fewer simultaneous instances.

outline:
统计单个 GPU 上的实例，而不是服务器中的 GPU 数量。
Count instances on one GPU rather than GPUs in a server.

使用最小受支持配置允许的最大数量。
Use the maximum permitted by the smallest supported profile.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 A，七个：H100 最小的受支持 GPU 实例配置，允许最多同时创建七个实例。
Choose A, seven: the smallest supported H100 GPU-instance profiles permit up to seven simultaneous instances.

whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：八份内存分区或 DGX 系统中的八个物理 GPU，不能与单个 H100 支持的七份 GPU 实例计算切片混淆。
Incorrect: eight memory fractions or eight physical GPUs in a DGX system must not be confused with seven supported GPU-instance compute slices on one H100.

不是最大值：更大内存的 1g 配置可以允许四个实例，但更小配置允许七个。
Not the maximum: a larger-memory 1g profile can allow four instances, but a smaller profile permits seven.

stem: What is a significant benefit of using containers in an AI development environment?
explanation:
选 B：封装代码与用户空间依赖，减少开发和部署之间的环境差异。
Choose B: packaging code and user-space dependencies reduces environment drift between development and deployment.

options.text: They increase the base accuracy of AI models by optimizing their algorithms.
options.translationZh: 通过优化算法，提高 AI 模型的基础准确率。

options.text: They ensure that AI applications run consistently across different computing environments.
options.translationZh: 确保 AI 应用在不同计算环境中一致运行。

options.text: They can automatically generate AI datasets for machine learning model training.
options.translationZh: 自动生成机器学习训练所需的 AI 数据集。

options.text: They directly increase the processing speed of GPUs used in AI computations.
options.translationZh: 直接提高 AI 计算所用 GPU 的处理速度。

sources.title: Docker: container fundamentals
sources.supports: Containers package applications with dependencies to improve portability and consistency.

sources.title: NVIDIA Container Toolkit prerequisites
sources.supports: GPU containers still require a compatible host GPU driver and supported runtime configuration.

outline:
识别依赖封装这一直接收益。
Identify dependency packaging as the direct benefit.

区分部署可移植性、模型质量与硬件速度。
Separate deployment portability from model quality and hardware speed.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 B：封装代码与用户空间依赖，减少开发和部署之间的环境差异。
Choose B: packaging code and user-space dependencies reduces environment drift between development and deployment.

whyNotChoose.text: They increase the base accuracy of AI models by optimizing their algorithms.
whyNotChoose.reason:
机制不对：封装应用不会改变学习算法，也不保证预测更准确。
Incorrect mechanism: packaging an application does not change its learning algorithm or guarantee better predictions.

whyNotChoose.text: They can automatically generate AI datasets for machine learning model training.
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：容器可以运行数据生成应用，但容器化本身不会生成训练样本。
Incorrect: a container may run a data-generation application, but containerization itself does not generate training examples.

whyNotChoose.text: They directly increase the processing speed of GPUs used in AI computations.
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：封装好的优化软件栈可能帮助应用，但容器不会直接增加 GPU 的物理处理能力。
Incorrect: a packaged optimized stack may help an application, but a container does not directly increase the GPU’s physical processing capability.

stem: Which architecture, training or inference, requires more data storage?
explanation:
在通常对比下选 B：训练需要保存数据集与检查点，基础推理服务主要加载训练好的模型并处理输入。

stem: Which characteristic best describes inference when comparing inference to deep learning training?
explanation:
A 是典型答案：基础推理不需要训练中的反向传播与优化器状态。实际硬件需求取决于模型规模、吞吐量与延迟目标。
A is the typical answer: basic inference avoids the training backward pass and optimizer state. Actual hardware demand depends on model size, throughput and latency targets.

options.translationZh: 推理需要较少的硬件资源。

options.text: Inference has larger data requirements.
options.translationZh: 推理的数据需求更大。

options.text: Inference takes longer to evaluate.
options.translationZh: 推理需要更长的评估时间。

stem: Which type of GPU core was designed to offer multi-precision computing for deep learning training and inference?
explanation:
选 C：Tensor Core 使用受支持的精度格式，加速深度学习核心的矩阵运算。
Choose C: Tensor Cores accelerate matrix operations central to deep learning using supported precision formats.

options.text: Ray Tracing Cores
options.translationZh: Ray Tracing Core 光线追踪核心。

options.text: CUDA Cores
options.translationZh: CUDA Core 通用计算核心。

options.text: Tensor Cores
options.translationZh: Tensor Core 张量核心。

sources.title: NVIDIA Turing architecture: Tensor Cores
sources.supports: Tensor Cores specialize in matrix operations and support multiple numerical formats; supported precisions vary by generation.

outline:
寻找专门处理密集矩阵算术的单元。
Look for the unit specialized for dense matrix arithmetic.

把它与光线求交硬件和通用算术单元区分开。
Distinguish it from ray-intersection hardware and general arithmetic units.

stem: What is the benefit of NGC?
explanation:
选 C：NGC 提供经过整理的 GPU 优化软件资产目录，帮助用户组合和部署受支持的工作流程。
Choose C: NGC offers a curated catalog of GPU-optimized software assets that helps users assemble and deploy supported workflows.

options.text: It provides licensing for GPU-optimized software.
options.translationZh: 提供 GPU 优化软件的许可证。

options.text: It provides air-gapped solution for secure environments.
options.translationZh: 为安全环境提供物理隔离网络方案。

options.text: It provides a curated set of GPU-optimized software.
options.translationZh: 提供经过整理的 GPU 优化软件集合。

sources.title: NVIDIA NGC Catalog user guide
sources.supports: NGC Catalog provides curated GPU-optimized assets including containers, models and tools; asset licensing and access conditions still apply.

outline:
识别目录的软件内容交付角色。
Identify the catalog’s content-delivery role.

把这个角色与许可权利、离线部署架构区分开。
Separate that role from licensing rights and disconnected deployment architecture.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 C：NGC 提供经过整理的 GPU 优化软件资产目录，帮助用户组合和部署受支持的工作流程。
Choose C: NGC offers a curated catalog of GPU-optimized software assets that helps users assemble and deploy supported workflows.

whyNotChoose.text: It provides licensing for GPU-optimized software.
whyNotChoose.reason:
不是定义性优势：NGC 可以提供有访问条款的软件，但目录中可获取不等于替代各产品所需的许可证。
Not the defining benefit: NGC can expose software with access terms, but catalog availability does not replace the license required by each product.

whyNotChoose.text: It provides air-gapped solution for secure environments.
whyNotChoose.reason:
作为目录通用功能不正确：离线环境必须明确转移和管理获准资产；在线目录本身不会建立物理隔离。
Incorrect as a general catalog feature: disconnected environments must explicitly transfer and manage approved artifacts; the online catalog alone does not establish an air gap.

stem: As an IT Professional, you have been assigned to optimize the performance of a deep learning model. Which of the following is a benefit of NVIDIA TensorRT?
explanation:
选 A：TensorRT 优化已训练模型的推理执行，目标是改善吞吐量与延迟。
Choose A: TensorRT optimizes execution of a trained model for inference, targeting efficient throughput and latency.

options.text: Improved inference performance and reduced latency.
options.translationZh: 提高推理性能并降低延迟。

options.text: Enhanced fine-tuning capabilities for deep learning models.
options.translationZh: 增强深度学习模型的微调能力。

options.text: Enhanced training capabilities for deep learning models.
options.translationZh: 增强深度学习模型的训练能力。

sources.supports: TensorRT optimizes trained models into deployment-specific inference engines.

outline:

Select inference optimization rather than fine-tuning or training.

stem: Which of the following statements is true about the difference between GPU and CPU architectures?
explanation:
B 符合传统简化示意图：GPU 偏重大量算术执行单元，CPU 偏重低延迟控制与缓存。绝对缓存大小取决于具体产品。
B matches the traditional simplified diagram: GPUs emphasize many arithmetic execution units, CPUs emphasize low-latency control and caching. Absolute cache size is product-specific.

outline:

explanation:
选 B：智能视频分析解释摄像头画面，检测人员与进入限制区域等事件。
Choose B: intelligent video analytics interprets camera streams to detect people and events such as crossing into a restricted region.

options.translationZh: 视频监控。

options.translationZh: 智能视频分析。

options.text: Signal Processing
options.translationZh: 信号处理。

sources.title: NVIDIA DeepStream
sources.supports: Provides infrastructure for real-time AI analysis of video and multisensor streams.

outline:

stem: Which of the following is a high-level specification related to cooling requirements within a data center?
explanation:
选 C：把机柜进风侧朝向冷通道、排风侧朝向热通道，有助于分离送风与受热回风。
Choose C: facing rack intakes toward cold aisles and exhausts toward hot aisles helps keep supply air separate from heated return air.

options.text: Utilizing a centralized air conditioning system to cool the entire data center.
options.translationZh: 使用集中式空调系统冷却整个数据中心。

options.text: Maintaining a constant humidity level of 2% throughout the facility.
options.translationZh: 整个设施始终维持 2% 的湿度。

options.text: Implementing a hot aisle/cold aisle layout to optimize airflow and cooling efficiency.
options.translationZh: 实施冷热通道布局，优化气流与冷却效率。

sources.title: US DOE: data center design best practices
sources.supports: Recommends separating hot and cold aisles and managing recirculation and bypass airflow.

sources.title: DGX H100/H200 hardware requirements
sources.supports: Documents rack dimensions, power and environmental operating requirements.

outline:
识别直接减少冷热气流混合的选项。
Identify the choice that directly reduces hot/cold air mixing.

排除随意的湿度目标与不完整的冷却设备描述。
Reject arbitrary humidity targets and incomplete descriptions of cooling equipment.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 C：把机柜进风侧朝向冷通道、排风侧朝向热通道，有助于分离送风与受热回风。
Choose C: facing rack intakes toward cold aisles and exhausts toward hot aisles helps keep supply air separate from heated return air.

whyNotChoose.text: Utilizing a centralized air conditioning system to cool the entire data center.
whyNotChoose.reason:
可能采用，但不充分：集中冷却设备可以提供冷空气，较差的机柜气流仍可能造成混风与热点。
Possible but insufficient: central cooling equipment may supply chilled air, while poor rack airflow can still create mixing and hot spots.

whyNotChoose.text: Maintaining a constant humidity level of 2% throughout the facility.
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误的统一要求：极干燥的 2% 不是通用数据中心规范，应遵循设备支持的温度、湿度与露点限制。
Incorrect blanket requirement: an extremely dry 2% target is not a generic data-center specification. Follow supported equipment temperature, humidity and dew-point limits.

选 C：把机柜进风侧朝向冷通道、排风侧朝向热通道，有助于分离送风与受热回风。
Choose C: facing rack intakes toward cold aisles and exhausts toward hot aisles helps keep supply air separate from heated return air.
learning.speedTipHtml:
冷风送进风口，热风进入回风路径。
Cold air to intakes; hot air to returns.

explanation:

sources.supports: Publishes the Message Passing Interface standards.

sources.supports: PVM uses message passing to coordinate distributed computation across a collection of computers.

outline:
寻找在协作进程之间交换消息的软件机制。
Look for software that exchanges messages between cooperating processes.

whyNotChoose.text: Linux and POSIX.

Incorrect scope: these target GPU programming and infrastructure acceleration. They can participate in cluster applications without being the intended MPI/PVM message-passing pair.

stem: What is a key feature of the GPUDirect protocol for transfers between GPUs and other PCIe devices?
explanation:
把术语纠正为 RDMA 后选 A：兼容的对等设备可以直接传入或传出 GPU 内存，减少由主机中转的拷贝。
Choose A with the corrected term RDMA: compatible peers can transfer data directly to or from GPU memory, reducing host-mediated copies.

options.text: It uses RDMA to reduce CPU data-copy bottlenecks.
options.originalText: It uses ROMA to eliminate CPU bottlenecks.
options.translationZh: 使用 RDMA 减少 CPU 数据拷贝瓶颈。

options.text: It uses virtual IP addresses to create private communication channels.
options.translationZh: 使用虚拟 IP 地址建立私有通信通道。

options.text: It uses the host's kernel.
options.translationZh: 使用主机的内核。

sources.title: GPUDirect RDMA programming guide
sources.supports: Describes direct GPU/PCIe-peer access and kernel-driver mappings needed to establish the path.

outline:
识别 GPU 内存与受支持 PCIe 对等设备间的直接访问。
Identify direct access between GPU memory and a supported PCIe peer.

区分传输数据路径与内存注册、映射及其他控制工作。
Separate the transfer data path from memory registration, mappings and other control work.
analysis.whyChoose:
把术语纠正为 RDMA 后选 A：兼容的对等设备可以直接传入或传出 GPU 内存，减少由主机中转的拷贝。
Choose A with the corrected term RDMA: compatible peers can transfer data directly to or from GPU memory, reducing host-mediated copies.

whyNotChoose.text: It uses virtual IP addresses to create private communication channels.
whyNotChoose.reason:
机制不符：IP 服务的虚拟地址不提供 GPUDirect RDMA 所定义的 PCIe 对等设备到 GPU 内存的访问。
Incorrect mechanism: virtual addressing for IP services does not provide the PCIe peer-to-GPU-memory access that defines GPUDirect RDMA.

whyNotChoose.text: It uses the host's kernel.
whyNotChoose.reason:
可以成立，但不是区分性特征：内核驱动建立映射与权限；这些控制工作不与直接对等数据路径矛盾。
Can be true but is not the distinguishing feature: kernel drivers establish mappings and permissions. That control work does not contradict a direct peer data path.

是 RDMA，不是 ROMA；直接数据路径仍需初始化。

GPUDirect is a technology family, not one universal protocol. Bypassing host-memory copies does not remove all CPU work or kernel-driver participation.

stem: What technology allows the lowest networking latency for AI training in a data center?
explanation:
选 C：InfiniBand 是面向高性能计算的专用互连，通常适合紧密耦合的多节点训练。
Choose C: InfiniBand is a purpose-built high-performance fabric commonly suited to tightly coupled multi-node training.

options.translationZh: 以太网。

options.text: Fibre Channel
options.translationZh: 光纤通道。

options.text: InfiniBand
options.translationZh: InfiniBand 高性能互连。

sources.title: NVIDIA InfiniBand platform
sources.supports: InfiniBand targets low latency, high throughput and communication offload.

sources.title: NVIDIA Dynamo: RDMA fabrics
sources.supports: Both InfiniBand and Ethernet RoCE can supply RDMA connectivity.

outline:
重点关注训练工作进程间的通信，而非仅存储访问。
Focus on communication between training workers, not solely storage access.

选择题目预期的高性能计算互连，同时保留实测比较的必要性。
Choose the intended HPC fabric while retaining the need for measured comparisons.
analysis.whyChoose:

Choose C: InfiniBand is a purpose-built high-performance fabric commonly suited to tightly coupled multi-node training.

whyNotChoose.text: Ethernet
whyNotChoose.reason:
不是题目的预期基准答案：普通以太网范围很广，而优化后的 RoCE 网络可以具有竞争力；不能说所有以太网都不适用。
Not the intended baseline answer: ordinary Ethernet is broad, while optimized RoCE fabrics can be competitive. It is incorrect to call all Ethernet inherently unsuitable.

whyNotChoose.text: Fibre Channel
whyNotChoose.reason:
主要角色不同：光纤通道主要服务于存储网络，而不是本题所指的 GPU 训练工作进程计算互连。
Different primary role: Fibre Channel principally serves storage networks, rather than the GPU-worker compute fabric targeted by this question.

stem: The data center administrator is asked to deploy infrastructure to support training of a large natural language processing model with a billion parameters and they need the fastest method to train the model. What should the administrator recommend to support this?
explanation:
C 是题目预期的可扩展集群答案。实际推荐最快方案需要基准测试；仅凭模型参数量，无法给这些未明确配置的系统排出速度顺序。
C is the intended scalable-cluster answer. A real fastest-time recommendation requires benchmarks; model parameter count alone cannot rank these unspecified configurations.

options.text: Single server with 4-8 NVIDIA GPUs.
options.translationZh: 一台配备 4–8 个 NVIDIA GPU 的服务器。

options.text: Two Node NVIDIA DGX Cluster.
options.translationZh: 一个双节点 NVIDIA DGX 集群。

options.text: NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD.

sources.title: NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD
sources.supports: Describes an integrated, scalable infrastructure for large AI training and inference workloads.

sources.title: PyTorch distributed data parallel tutorial
sources.supports: Distributed training requires process coordination and gradient synchronization.

outline:
识别题目从单服务器到大型集成集群的预期规模递进。
Recognize the intended progression from one server to a larger integrated cluster.

实际采购前，测量工作负载扩展能力，以及达到同等质量目标的总时间。
Before an actual purchase, measure workload scaling and total time to the same quality target.

Not the intended largest-scale answer, but potentially sufficient and fast for this model. The question supplies too little hardware and workload detail to rule it out empirically.

whyNotChoose.text: Software Defined Network (SDN)
whyNotChoose.reason:
比较层次不对：SDN 描述可编程网络控制；实际延迟与带宽取决于底层网络和实现。
Wrong comparison level: SDN describes programmable network control. Its actual latency and bandwidth depend on the underlying fabric and implementation.

whyNotChoose.text: Fibre Channel
whyNotChoose.reason:
不是预期的计算互连：光纤通道主要承载存储流量，而多节点训练需要高效的工作进程间通信。
Not the intended compute interconnect: Fibre Channel mainly carries storage traffic, whereas multi-node training needs efficient worker-to-worker communication.

summary.zh: 选 C：InfiniBand 提供适合节点间交换训练数据的低延迟、高吞吐通信。

memory.en: Compute fabric: InfiniBand. Storage fabric: Fibre Channel. Network control: SDN.
memory.zh: 计算互连：InfiniBand；存储互连：光纤通道；网络控制：SDN。

pitfall.en: These choices mix abstraction levels. SDN is not a performance rating, and a tuned RoCE fabric can also support distributed AI.
pitfall.zh: 这些选项混合了抽象层次。SDN 不是性能等级，调优后的 RoCE 网络也能支持分布式 AI。

steps.en: Focus on collective communication between training workers.
steps.zh: 关注训练工作进程之间的集合通信。

steps.en: Select the suitable compute interconnect rather than a management approach or storage-only emphasis.
steps.zh: 选择合适的计算互连，而非管理方法或主要面向存储的方案。

A.zh: 软件定义网络（SDN）。

reason.en: Wrong comparison level: SDN describes programmable network control. Its actual latency and bandwidth depend on the underlying fabric and implementation.
reason.zh: 比较层次不对：SDN 描述可编程网络控制；实际延迟与带宽取决于底层网络和实现。

B.zh: 光纤通道。

reason.en: Not the intended compute interconnect: Fibre Channel mainly carries storage traffic, whereas multi-node training needs efficient worker-to-worker communication.
reason.zh: 不是预期的计算互连：光纤通道主要承载存储流量，而多节点训练需要高效的工作进程间通信。

C.zh: InfiniBand 高性能互连。

reason.en: Best option here: RDMA, bandwidth and communication offload suit tightly coupled training. A real optimum still requires workload measurements.
reason.zh: 在这些选项中最佳：RDMA、带宽与通信卸载适合紧密耦合训练；实际最优方案仍需测量工作负载。

stem: In a data center, what is the key purpose of a UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply)?
explanation:
选 A：市电中断时，UPS 暂时供电，为切换其他电源或有序关机争取时间。
Choose A: a UPS temporarily supplies power during a utility outage, buying time for another power source or an orderly shutdown.

options.text: To provide backup power in case of a power outage.
options.translationZh: 在停电时提供备用电力。

options.text: To cool the data center and maintain optimal temperature.
options.translationZh: 冷却数据中心并保持最佳温度。

options.text: To regulate the voltage of incoming power to prevent damage to equipment.
options.translationZh: 调节输入电压，防止设备损坏。

sources.title: Eaton: UPS selection and operation
sources.supports: Explains battery backup runtime, generator supplementation and voltage regulation in line-interactive and online UPS systems.

outline:
先判断主电源消失时需要什么。
Identify what happens when the main supply disappears.

区分断电期间的供电连续性、冷却与电源调节。
Distinguish outage continuity from cooling and power conditioning.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 A：市电中断时，UPS 暂时供电，为切换其他电源或有序关机争取时间。
Choose A: a UPS temporarily supplies power during a utility outage, buying time for another power source or an orderly shutdown.

whyNotChoose.text: To cool the data center and maintain optimal temperature.
whyNotChoose.reason:
设备角色不符：冷却系统负责移走热量；UPS 可以给部分冷却设备供电，但自身不执行冷却功能。
Incorrect equipment role: cooling systems remove heat. A UPS may power selected cooling equipment, but does not itself perform the cooling function.

whyNotChoose.text: To regulate the voltage of incoming power to prevent damage to equipment.
whyNotChoose.reason:
在适当设计中确实是附加能力，但不是主要用途的最佳答案：仅调节电压，不能在电源消失后继续维持负载。
A real secondary capability in suitable designs, but not the best answer to the key purpose: voltage conditioning alone cannot sustain a load after power disappears.

stem: What is an important consideration to ensure that proper airflow is provided through a data center rack?
explanation:
选 B：在未使用的机柜 U 位开口安装盲板，减少热排风回流到设备进风侧。
Choose B: fill unused rack-unit openings with blanking panels so hot exhaust does not easily recirculate to equipment intakes.

options.text: Cabinet doors should be left open at all times.
options.translationZh: 机柜门应始终敞开。

options.text: Blanking panels are installed wherever possible.
options.translationZh: 尽可能安装盲板（应限定为未使用的机柜开口）。

options.text: All systems should include dual-rotor fans and copper heatsinks.
options.translationZh: 所有系统都应包含双转子风扇与铜散热片。

sources.title: US DOE: data center design best practices
sources.supports: Recommends blocking vacant rack slots and managing openings to reduce exhaust recirculation and supply-air bypass.

outline:
沿着预期进风到排风路径分析。
Trace the intended intake-to-exhaust path.

封住绕过设备的非预期气流捷径，同时保持设计通风口畅通。
Block unintended shortcuts around equipment while keeping designed vents clear.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 B：在未使用的机柜 U 位开口安装盲板，减少热排风回流到设备进风侧。
Choose B: fill unused rack-unit openings with blanking panels so hot exhaust does not easily recirculate to equipment intakes.

whyNotChoose.text: Cabinet doors should be left open at all times.
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误的统一规则：门板开孔与气流封闭属于设计的一部分；始终开门可能破坏该设计与物理安全。
Incorrect blanket rule: door perforation and containment are part of the designed airflow system. Leaving doors open can disrupt that design and security.

whyNotChoose.text: All systems should include dual-rotor fans and copper heatsinks.
whyNotChoose.reason:
不是通用机柜气流要求：冷却组件取决于服务器设计，这些零件本身不能防止机柜层面的冷热混风。
Not a universal rack-airflow requirement: cooling components depend on server design, and those parts alone do not prevent rack-level air mixing.

stem: What common bottleneck does GPU Direct Storage avoid?
explanation:
选 C：受支持的直接路径把存储数据送到 GPU 内存，避免通常的中间主机内存拷贝。
Choose C: the supported direct path moves storage data to GPU memory without the usual intermediate host-memory copy.

options.text: Low network bandwidth.
options.translationZh: 网络带宽不足。

options.text: Storage fabric bandwidth.
options.translationZh: 存储网络的带宽限制。

options.text: Using the CPU to copy data.
options.translationZh: 使用 CPU 中转拷贝数据。

sources.title: GPUDirect Storage overview
sources.supports: A direct DMA storage/GPU path avoids CPU bounce-buffer staging where supported, while compatibility modes may still use staging.

outline:
追踪传统路径：存储 → 主机缓冲区 → GPU。
Trace storage → host buffer → GPU in the conventional path.

识别直接路径移除了哪次中间拷贝。
Identify which intermediate copy the direct path removes.
analysis.whyChoose:

whyNotChoose.text: Low network bandwidth.
whyNotChoose.reason:
不会直接消除：即使 GDS 提高端点数据路径效率，较慢网络链路仍会限制远程存储吞吐量。

whyNotChoose.text: Storage fabric bandwidth.

Not increased by GDS: fabric, controller and drive limits remain. Eliminating staging can improve utilization but cannot exceed the underlying path’s capacity.

stem: How does NVSwitch contribute to accelerating network performance in an AI environment?
explanation:
选 A：NVSwitch 通过 NVLink 连接 GPU，使对等流量可避免主机中转拷贝，使用高带宽 GPU 互连。
Choose A: NVSwitch connects GPUs through NVLink so peer traffic can avoid host-mediated copies and use a high-bandwidth GPU fabric.

options.text: NVSwitch reduces network latency by enabling direct communication between GPUs without going through the CPU.
options.translationZh: 让 GPU 无需经 CPU 中转即可直接通信，从而降低通信延迟。

options.text: NVSwitch amplifies the bandwidth of traditional Ethernet networks to speed up AI data processing.
options.translationZh: 放大传统以太网的带宽，以加速 AI 数据处理。

options.text: NVSwitch enhances signal strength for better wireless connectivity in AI applications.
options.translationZh: 增强信号强度，改善 AI 应用的无线连接。

options.text: NVSwitch increases the storage capacity of AI systems by directly connecting to solid-state drives (SSDs).
options.translationZh: 直接连接固态硬盘，增加 AI 系统的存储容量。

outline:

Separate GPU communication from Ethernet, Wi-Fi and disk capacity.

stem: Which data format is best for efficient and accurate AI model training?
explanation:
选 A 所代表的总体策略：在适合处使用更快的低精度运算，为数值敏感工作保留足够精度，并验证收敛。
Choose A as the broad strategy: use faster lower-precision operations where suitable and retain enough precision for numerically sensitive work, validating convergence.

options.text: Mixed precision (FP8/FP16/TF32/FP32).
options.translationZh: 混合精度（例如 FP8／FP16／TF32／FP32）。

options.text: Brain Floating-point format (BF16).
options.translationZh: Brain Floating-point 格式（BF16）。

options.text: Double-precision floating point (FP64).
options.translationZh: 双精度浮点格式（FP64）。

sources.title: NVIDIA mixed-precision training
sources.supports: Combines lower-precision computation with higher precision where necessary, including FP16 loss-scaling techniques.

sources.title: PyTorch automatic mixed precision
sources.supports: Mixed precision selects FP16 or BF16 and FP32 for suitable operations; BF16 is a valid mixed-precision component.

sources.title: PyTorch numerical accuracy
sources.supports: Explains reduced precision, TF32 tensor-core calculations and numerical tradeoffs.

outline:
区分混合精度策略与某一种固定数值类型。
Distinguish a mixed-precision strategy from one fixed numerical type.

检查硬件支持、上溢／下溢，并与参考训练比较收敛表现。
Check hardware support, overflow/underflow and convergence against the reference training run.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 A 所代表的总体策略：在适合处使用更快的低精度运算，为数值敏感工作保留足够精度，并验证收敛。
Choose A as the broad strategy: use faster lower-precision operations where suitable and retain enough precision for numerically sensitive work, validating convergence.

whyNotChoose.text: Brain Floating-point format (BF16).
whyNotChoose.reason:
这是有效训练格式，并非本身错误；它指单一格式而非总体策略，也常与 FP32 结合用于混合精度训练。
A valid training format, not inherently wrong. It names one format rather than the broader strategy and is often combined with FP32 in mixed-precision training.

whyNotChoose.text: Double-precision floating point (FP64).
whyNotChoose.reason:
当数值要求确有需要时有用，但对于题目以效率为重点的典型深度学习场景，通常带来较高内存与吞吐成本。
Useful when numerical requirements justify it, but usually too costly in memory and throughput for the intended efficiency-focused deep-learning baseline.

stem: What are some of the key benefits of investing in GPUs from a cloud service provider?
explanation:
选 A：租用可用 GPU 容量减少前期硬件采购，相比购置自有服务器，可以更灵活地调整规模。
Choose A: renting available GPU capacity reduces initial hardware purchasing and can make scaling more flexible than procuring owned servers.

options.text: Low financial barrier to entry and ability to rapidly scale up or down.
options.translationZh: 较低的初始资金门槛，并可快速扩大或缩小规模。

options.text: Higher performance GPUs than on-premise.
options.translationZh: GPU 性能高于本地部署。

options.text: Full stack control of the environment and choice of networking.
options.translationZh: 完全控制整个环境栈，并自由选择网络。

sources.title: AWS: cloud versus on premises
sources.supports: Compares ownership, control, capital investment and cloud provisioning flexibility.

outline:
比较资源配置与所有权模式，而非未给定的 GPU 基准性能。
Compare provisioning and ownership models, not an unspecified GPU benchmark.

区分较低进入成本、整个生命周期成本与物理控制权。
Separate lower entry cost from total lifetime cost and physical control.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 A：租用可用 GPU 容量减少前期硬件采购，相比购置自有服务器，可以更灵活地调整规模。
Choose A: renting available GPU capacity reduces initial hardware purchasing and can make scaling more flexible than procuring owned servers.

whyNotChoose.text: Higher performance GPUs than on-premise.
whyNotChoose.reason:
不是固有优势：性能取决于 GPU 型号、拓扑、共享方式与工作负载；处于云上本身不会让同等硬件更快。
Not inherent: performance depends on the GPU model, topology, sharing and workload. Cloud location alone does not make equivalent hardware faster.

whyNotChoose.text: Full stack control of the environment and choice of networking.
whyNotChoose.reason:
夸大了客户控制权：即使客户能广泛控制实例或虚拟网络，提供商仍限制物理硬件与网络选择。
Overstates customer control: providers constrain physical hardware and networking choices, even when customers have extensive control inside instances or virtual networks.

learning.stemHtml: What are some of the key benefits of investing in GPUs from a cloud service provider?从云服务提供商获取 GPU 资源有哪些主要优势？
learning.keyPointHtml:
选 A：租用可用 GPU 容量减少前期硬件采购，相比购置自有服务器，可以更灵活地调整规模。
Choose A: renting available GPU capacity reduces initial hardware purchasing and can make scaling more flexible than procuring owned servers.
learning.speedTipHtml:
云的灵活性：减少前期采购，容量与账单随使用变化。
Cloud flexibility: less upfront purchase, variable capacity and bills.
studyNotesHtml:
弹性不等于无限，也不等于始终更便宜；GPU 配额、区域库存、预留、传输费用与长期利用率都会影响结果。
Elastic does not mean unlimited or always cheaper. GPU quotas, regional stock, reservations, transfer costs and long-running utilization affect the result.

stem: How many out-of-band network management connections are in a DGX H100 system?
explanation:
选 A，一个：DGX H100 硬件规格列出一个用于带外管理的专用 1 GbE RJ45 BMC 端口。
Choose A, one: the DGX H100 hardware specification identifies a dedicated 1 GbE RJ45 BMC port for out-of-band management.

options.translationZh: 一个。
四个。
两个。

sources.title: DGX H100/H200 hardware guide
sources.supports: Lists one 1 GbE RJ45 BMC interface separately from system management interfaces and describes BMC-only standby availability.

sources.title: DGX H100/H200 console connections
sources.supports: Connects remote out-of-band management through the BMC port, separately from SSH to the OS.

outline:
找到硬件表中明确标注 BMC／带外管理的一行。
Find the hardware row explicitly labeled BMC/out-of-band management.

不把单独列出的操作系统／系统管理网络接口计入。
Keep the separate OS/system management network interfaces out of that count.

stem: What is the maximum number of GPU instances you can partition with NVIDIA MIG (Multi-Instance GPU)?
explanation:
选 A：在相关受支持 GPU 与最小配置规格上，最多七个；实际数量取决于 GPU 型号与所选实例大小。
Choose A, up to seven on the relevant supported GPUs and smallest profiles. Actual counts depend on the GPU and the chosen instance sizes.

options.translationZh: 七个。
三个。
五个。
九个。

sources.title: NVIDIA supported MIG profiles
sources.supports: A100/H100 and other supported profiles permit seven small GPU instances; some GPU models and larger profiles allow fewer.

outline:
统计一个物理 GPU 的分区，而不是服务器中的 GPU 数量。
Count partitions of one physical GPU, not GPUs in a server.

用受支持的配置表确定最多可创建的数量。

stem: What is the primary function of a Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) on a system in an AI environment?
explanation:
选 B：只要待机电源与管理连接可用，BMC 就可独立于主机操作系统提供带外监控、控制台与电源控制。
Choose B: a BMC provides out-of-band monitoring, console and power control independently of the host OS, while standby power and management connectivity remain available.

options.text: It serves as the main data storage controller, managing all hard drives and SSDs within the server.
options.translationZh: 作为主存储控制器，管理服务器全部硬盘与 SSD。

options.text: It allows for out-of-band remote management of the device, even when the system is powered off.
options.translationZh: 提供带外远程管理，即使主机已关闭也可使用。

options.text: It functions as a hardware-based firewall, protecting the server from external threats.
options.translationZh: 充当硬件防火墙，保护服务器免受外部威胁。

options.text: It acts as a primary in-band network interface, controlling all inbound and outbound network traffic.
options.translationZh: 作为主要带内网卡，控制所有进出网络流量。

outline:
识别独立于主机操作系统的管理能力。

Choose B: a BMC provides out-of-band monitoring, console and power control independently of the host OS, while standby power and management connectivity remain available.

whyNotChoose.text: It serves as the main data storage controller, managing all hard drives and SSDs within the server.

stem: What is the benefit of Kubernetes in application deployments in an AI environment?
explanation:
选 D：Kubernetes 管理应用副本与服务端点，帮助部署和扩展容器化 AI 服务。
Choose D: Kubernetes manages application replicas and service endpoints, helping deploy and scale containerized AI services.

options.text: It simplifies deployment through automation of AI algorithms for machine learning models.
options.translationZh: 通过自动化机器学习模型的 AI 算法来简化部署。

options.text: It improves scaling through enhancement of the computational power of GPUs used in AI workloads.
options.translationZh: 通过增强 AI 工作负载使用的 GPU 算力来改善扩展能力。

options.text: It simplifies deployment and directly improves the accuracy of AI models by optimizing their hyperparameters.
options.translationZh: 简化部署，并通过优化超参数直接提高模型准确率。

options.text: It improves scaling of applications by allowing for automated replication and load balancing of containers.
options.translationZh: 通过自动维护容器应用副本与负载均衡来改善应用扩展能力。

stem: What is a significant benefit of using Slurm in high-performance computing (HPC) environments?
explanation:

options.text: Slurm provides an orchestration tool to compile drivers and libraries in an HPC environment.

stem: Which platform allows for the simple deployment of scalable AI models in production?
explanation:
选 C：NVIDIA Triton Inference Server 为生产推理提供服务 API、模型后端与请求调度。
Choose C: NVIDIA Triton Inference Server supplies serving APIs, model backends and request scheduling for production inference.

sources.title: NVIDIA Triton Inference Server
sources.supports: Provides model serving, backends, scheduling, batching and APIs for production inference.

sources.title: TensorFlow Serving
sources.supports: TensorFlow has a distinct production-serving system; the TensorFlow option is broader.

sources.title: NVIDIA TensorRT
sources.supports: TensorRT optimizes and executes inference engines and can be used as a serving backend.

outline:
识别服务层，而非模型框架或执行引擎优化器。
Identify the serving layer rather than a model framework or engine optimizer.

把请求 API 与模型调度对应到推理服务器。
Associate request APIs and model scheduling with an inference server.

whyNotChoose.text: TensorFlow
whyNotChoose.reason:
不够具体：TensorFlow 支持模型开发与执行，其生态也有 TensorFlow Serving；本题所指的 NVIDIA 专用服务产品是 Triton。

whyNotChoose.reason:

Different layer: TensorRT optimizes and runs inference engines, but does not by itself represent the complete multi-model serving layer described here.

stem: What distinguishes GPU architecture from CPU architecture?
explanation:
选 A：GPU 把大量硬件用于并行算术运算，CPU 通常更重视灵活控制与单个线程的快速执行。
Choose A: GPUs devote substantial hardware to many parallel arithmetic operations, while CPUs generally emphasize flexible control and fast individual threads.

options.text: GPUs have thousands of smaller cores for parallel tasks.
options.translationZh: GPU 通常有大量较简单的运算核心，用于并行任务。

options.text: CPUs have more cores than GPUs.
options.translationZh: CPU 的核心数比 GPU 更多。

options.text: CPUs lack memory bandwidth.
options.translationZh: CPU 没有内存带宽。

options.text: GPUs prioritize single-threaded performance.
options.translationZh: GPU 优先考虑单线程性能。

whyNotChoose.text: CPUs have more cores than GPUs.
whyNotChoose.reason:

whyNotChoose.text: CPUs lack memory bandwidth.
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：CPU 通过内存控制器与缓存传输数据，具有有限且可测量的带宽；这是 CPU 运行必需的能力。

whyNotChoose.text: GPUs prioritize single-threaded performance.

stem: Which networking protocol is critical for low-latency GPU communication in AI clusters?
explanation:
选 D：RoCE 在以太网上提供 RDMA，在硬件与软件支持时减少主机中转传输工作。
Choose D: RoCE supplies RDMA over Ethernet, reducing host-mediated transfer work when the hardware and software support it.

options.text: TCP/IP
options.translationZh: TCP/IP 协议族。

options.text: HTTP/3
options.translationZh: HTTP/3 网页应用协议。

options.text: DNS
options.translationZh: DNS 域名系统。

options.text: RoCE
options.translationZh: RoCE，融合以太网上的 RDMA。

sources.supports: Supported peer devices can access GPU memory through a configured direct path.

outline:
识别专门提供以太网 RDMA 的协议。
Identify the protocol specifically providing Ethernet RDMA.

区分传输加速、网页协议与名称解析。
Distinguish transfer acceleration from web protocols and name resolution.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 D：RoCE 在以太网上提供 RDMA，在硬件与软件支持时减少主机中转传输工作。
Choose D: RoCE supplies RDMA over Ethernet, reducing host-mediated transfer work when the hardware and software support it.

whyNotChoose.text: TCP/IP
whyNotChoose.reason:
可以用于集群通信，但普通套接字传输本身不提供这里所指的 RoCE 式 RDMA 卸载。
Usable for cluster communication, but ordinary socket transport does not by itself supply the RoCE-style RDMA offload intended here.

whyNotChoose.text: HTTP/3
whyNotChoose.reason:
层次与用途不符：HTTP/3 在 QUIC 上承载应用请求，不定义对 GPU 或主机内存的远程直接访问。
Wrong layer and purpose: HTTP/3 carries application requests over QUIC, rather than defining remote direct access to GPU or host memory.

whyNotChoose.text: DNS
whyNotChoose.reason:
功能不符：DNS 解析名称与相关记录，不负责在 GPU 内存之间传送训练张量。
Incorrect function: DNS resolves names and related records; it does not move training tensors between GPU memories.
