stem: What is a key architectural difference between AI training and inference?
explanation:
选 C：训练反复优化参数，交互式推理则通常要求已训练模型及时响应。
Choose C: training repeatedly optimizes parameters, while interactive inference commonly targets timely responses from an already trained model.

options.text: Inference workloads cannot utilize GPU acceleration; training requires GPU acceleration for efficiency.
options.translationZh: 推理不能使用 GPU 加速，而训练需要 GPU 加速才能高效运行。

options.text: Training uses dedicated DPU resources for optimization; inference uses CPU resources for predictions.
options.translationZh: 训练使用专用 DPU 优化资源，推理使用 CPU 生成预测。

options.text: Training requires high compute power for parameter optimization; inference prioritizes low latency.
options.translationZh: 训练需要较强算力优化参数；推理通常注重低延迟。

options.text: Inference requires deployment on multiple GPUs; training requires fewer GPUs for operation.
options.translationZh: 推理必须部署到多个 GPU，而训练需要更少 GPU。

sources.title: Triton Inference Server
sources.supports: Inference includes real-time, batched and streaming query types on CPUs and GPUs.

aiStudy.reviewNote: Retained C for training versus interactive inference. Batch inference also emphasizes throughput; training does not universally require GPUs, and inference may use either CPUs or GPUs.

summary.en: Choose C: training repeatedly optimizes parameters, while interactive inference commonly targets timely responses from an already trained model.
summary.zh: 选 C：训练反复优化参数，交互式推理则通常要求已训练模型及时响应。

memory.en: Training learns parameters; inference uses them under service targets.
memory.zh: 训练学习参数；推理在服务目标下使用参数。

pitfall.en: Low latency is especially important for interactive inference, not a universal priority over throughput in every batch service. Hardware counts depend on the model and demand.
pitfall.zh: 低延迟对交互式推理尤其重要，但不是每种批处理服务都优先于吞吐量；硬件数量取决于模型与需求。

steps.en: Separate parameter updates from applying the trained function.
steps.zh: 区分更新参数与使用已训练函数。

steps.en: Interpret the latency emphasis in an interactive-serving context.
steps.zh: 在交互式服务语境中理解延迟重点。

A.zh: 推理不能使用 GPU 加速，而训练需要 GPU 加速才能高效运行。

reason.en: False exclusion: inference can run on GPUs, and training can also run on CPUs when suitable. The phases are not defined by exclusive hardware types.
reason.zh: 错误排除：推理可以运行在 GPU 上，合适时训练也可以在 CPU 上运行；二者不是由互斥硬件类型定义的。

B.zh: 训练使用专用 DPU 优化资源，推理使用 CPU 生成预测。

reason.en: Incorrect division: DPUs mainly offload infrastructure services; model parameter optimization is not their defining role, and inference is not CPU-only.
reason.zh: 划分错误：DPU 主要卸载基础设施服务，模型参数优化不是其定义性角色，推理也不限于 CPU。

C.zh: 训练需要较强算力优化参数；推理通常注重低延迟。

reason.en: Best typical answer: training performs repeated learning computations, whereas an interactive inference service must meet response-time targets. Batch serving adds throughput goals.
reason.zh: 典型场景的最佳答案：训练进行反复学习计算，交互式推理服务需满足响应时间目标；批量服务还重视吞吐量。

D.zh: 推理必须部署到多个 GPU，而训练需要更少 GPU。

reason.en: Not a general requirement: both phases may use one or many devices, depending on model memory, parallelism and workload scale.
reason.zh: 不是一般要求：两个阶段都可能使用一个或多个设备，取决于模型内存、并行方式与工作负载规模。

stem: In the context of data center use cases, what is the primary purpose of NVIDIA AI Factories?
explanation:
C 最接近：AI Factory 集成覆盖 AI 生命周期的基础设施与流程，包括数据准备、训练和生产推理。
C is the closest answer: an AI Factory integrates infrastructure and workflows across the AI lifecycle, including data preparation, training and production inference.

options.text: To enhance traditional data storage solutions with advanced AI capabilities.
options.translationZh: 为传统数据存储方案增加高级 AI 功能。

options.text: To serve as a backup solution for critical data in real time environments.
options.translationZh: 在实时环境中充当关键数据的备份方案。

options.text: To optimize machine learning workflows by integrating data processing and AI model training.
options.translationZh: 通过集成数据处理与 AI 模型训练来优化机器学习工作流。

options.text: To provide high-performance computing for large-scale simulations.
options.translationZh: 为大型仿真提供高性能计算。

sources.supports: Defines integrated infrastructure spanning data ingestion, training, fine-tuning and high-volume inference, rather than a storage or backup-only product.

whyNotChoose.text: To enhance traditional data storage solutions with advanced AI capabilities.
whyNotChoose.reason:
范围太窄：存储只是一个组件，AI Factory 集成计算、网络、软件与生命周期运营，以产生 AI 输出。
Too narrow: storage is one component, while an AI Factory integrates compute, networking, software and lifecycle operations to produce AI outputs.

whyNotChoose.reason:
主要目标不符：备份保护数据，而 AI Factory 的目的是运行集成的 AI 生产流程。
Incorrect primary objective: backup protects data, whereas the AI Factory’s purpose is running integrated AI production workflows.

whyNotChoose.text: To provide high-performance computing for large-scale simulations.
whyNotChoose.reason:
可能是支持的工作负载，但不是围绕完整 AI 生命周期组织基础设施的区分性目标。
A possible supported workload, but not the distinguishing purpose of an infrastructure organized around the full AI lifecycle.

stem: Which factor is most important when selecting a network fabric for distributed deep learning training across multiple GPUs and nodes?
explanation:
选 B：足够带宽与较低延迟，可减少张量传输和分布式训练进程协调所耗时间。
Choose B: sufficient bandwidth and low latency reduce the time spent moving tensors and coordinating distributed training workers.

options.text: Built-in web filtering
options.translationZh: 内置网页过滤。

options.text: High bandwidth and low latency
options.translationZh: 高带宽与低延迟。

options.text: Wireless connectivity
options.translationZh: 无线连接。

options.text: Support for IPv6
options.translationZh: 支持 IPv6。

sources.title: NCCL overview
sources.supports: Collective communication and synchronization affect multi-GPU and multi-node training performance.

sources.title: NVIDIA Dynamo RDMA fabrics
sources.supports: Distinguishes InfiniBand and Ethernet RoCE fabrics and their RDMA requirements.

outline:
识别并行训练进程之间反复发生的通信。
Identify repeated communication among parallel training workers.

选择直接减少传输与协调时间的性能特性。
Choose performance properties that directly reduce transfer and coordination time.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 B：足够带宽与较低延迟，可减少张量传输和分布式训练进程协调所耗时间。
Choose B: sufficient bandwidth and low latency reduce the time spent moving tensors and coordinating distributed training workers.

whyNotChoose.text: Built-in web filtering
whyNotChoose.reason:
这是面向另一类流量用途的安全功能，不能解决张量通信的带宽与同步延迟问题。
A security feature for a different traffic purpose; it does not address the bandwidth and synchronization delays of tensor communication.

whyNotChoose.text: Wireless connectivity
whyNotChoose.reason:
不是关键要求：分布式训练网络通常需要可预测的高容量连接；仅有无线接入并不提供这种性能保证。
Not the key requirement: distributed training fabrics generally need predictable high-capacity connections; wireless access alone offers no such performance guarantee.

whyNotChoose.text: Support for IPv6
whyNotChoose.reason:
可能对地址规划与集成重要，但支持 IPv6 本身不意味着高吞吐或低通信延迟。
May matter for addressing and integration, but IPv6 support alone does not imply high throughput or low communication latency.

stem: Which tool is designed for container orchestration in AI clusters?
explanation:
选 A：Kubernetes 管理跨集群节点的容器化应用部署与生命周期。
Choose A: Kubernetes manages deployment and lifecycle of containerized applications across cluster nodes.

options.text: Kubernetes
options.translationZh: Kubernetes 容器编排平台。

options.text: PostgreSQL
options.translationZh: PostgreSQL 数据库。

options.text: Apache Spark
options.translationZh: Apache Spark 数据处理引擎。

options.text: SLURM
options.translationZh: Slurm 作业调度系统。

sources.title: Kubernetes overview
sources.supports: Kubernetes manages containerized applications, scheduling, scaling and service lifecycle.

sources.title: Slurm overview
sources.supports: Slurm allocates resources and schedules, starts and monitors distributed jobs.

sources.title: PostgreSQL overview
sources.supports: PostgreSQL is an object-relational database.

sources.title: Apache Spark cluster overview
sources.supports: Spark runs distributed data-processing tasks using executors and can use Kubernetes as its cluster manager.

outline:
识别所问层次：跨节点的容器生命周期。
Identify the requested layer: container lifecycle across nodes.

区分数据库、处理引擎与编排平台。
Distinguish databases and processing engines from the orchestrator.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 A：Kubernetes 管理跨集群节点的容器化应用部署与生命周期。
Choose A: Kubernetes manages deployment and lifecycle of containerized applications across cluster nodes.

whyNotChoose.text: PostgreSQL
whyNotChoose.reason:
角色不符：PostgreSQL 存储和查询数据；它可以运行在容器内，但不会因此成为集群编排器。
Incorrect role: PostgreSQL stores and queries data; it may run inside a container but does not thereby orchestrate the cluster.

whyNotChoose.text: Apache Spark
whyNotChoose.reason:
层次不同：Spark 分发数据处理任务，并可使用 Kubernetes 管理运行执行器的资源。
Different layer: Spark distributes data-processing tasks and can use Kubernetes to manage the resources running its executors.

whyNotChoose.text: SLURM
whyNotChoose.reason:
主要是作业与资源调度器，也能调度容器化作业；题目所指的通用容器编排平台是 Kubernetes。
Primarily a job and resource scheduler, including for containerized jobs. Kubernetes is the intended general-purpose container orchestration platform.

stem: Engineers are troubleshooting slow step-time and poor scaling efficiency in a multi-rack distributed AI training cluster. Which infrastructure change is MOST likely to improve end-to-end training performance?
explanation:
当集合通信限制扩展时选 D：改进节点间互连，并针对实际 AllReduce 工作负载调优。
Choose D when collective communication limits scaling: improve the inter-node fabric and tune its behavior for the actual AllReduce workload.

options.text: Migrate inter-node communication to a secured Wi-Fi 6 mesh to reduce cabling complexity in the data center.
options.translationZh: 改用安全 Wi-Fi 6 网状网络进行节点间通信，以简化布线。

options.text: Increase the number of top-of-rack switch ports while keeping the same oversubscribed Layer 3 Ethernet design.
options.translationZh: 增加机柜顶交换机端口，但保留相同的超售三层以太网设计。

options.text: Insert stateful firewalls with deep-packet inspection between training nodes to better control east-west traffic flows.
options.translationZh: 在训练节点间加入带深度包检测的有状态防火墙。

options.text: Deploy a lossless InfiniBand or RoCE-based high-bandwidth, low-latency fabric and tune it for all- reduce traffic.
options.translationZh: 部署并调优具有适当无丢包设计的高带宽、低延迟 InfiniBand 或 RoCE 网络，使其适配全归约流量。

outline:

whyNotChoose.text: Migrate inter-node communication to a secured Wi-Fi 6 mesh to reduce cabling complexity in the data center.
whyNotChoose.reason:
不匹配：共享无线容量与可变延迟，不能直接解决这里需要的可预测高吞吐集合通信。
Poor match: shared wireless capacity and variable delay do not directly solve the predictable high-throughput collective traffic required here.

Insufficient: more access ports do not remove a constrained inter-rack uplink or an unchanged oversubscription bottleneck.

whyNotChoose.text: Insert stateful firewalls with deep-packet inspection between training nodes to better control east-west traffic flows.
whyNotChoose.reason:
这是安全决策，不是直接性能修复；插入检测设备可能增加处理延迟或新的吞吐上限。
A security decision rather than a direct performance remedy; inserting inspection can add processing delay or a new throughput limit.

originalExplanation: End-to-end distributed training is often limited by collective communication, especially all-reduce across racks. NVIDIA’s NCCL is optimized for high-bandwidth, low-latency interconnects such as InfiniBand and RoCE, and its documentation specifically notes optimization over InfiniBand and RoCE to maximize performance for collectives like all-reduce. A lossless RDMA-capable fabric therefore most directly improves step time and scaling efficiency in multi-node training.

explanation:

Choose A: high memory bandwidth supports transfers, while useful reuse in shared memory can reduce repeated global-memory accesses.

options.text: Large shared memory and high-bandwidth buses.
options.translationZh: 较充足的共享内存与高带宽总线。

options.text: Increase number of IO ports for PCIe devices.
options.translationZh: 增加 PCIe 设备的 I/O 端口数量。

options.text: Dedicated and proprietary inference ASICs.
options.translationZh: 专用且私有的推理 ASIC。

options.text: Direct wiring of GPUs as main disk controllers.

sources.title: CUDA C++ Best Practices Guide: memory optimization
sources.supports: Shared-memory reuse can reduce global-memory traffic; effective bandwidth, access patterns and occupancy matter.

outline:
测量有效带宽，定位受限的内存路径。
Measure effective bandwidth and locate the limiting memory path.

采用适当的合并访问与复用，而不是仅增加无关端口。
Use appropriate coalescing and reuse rather than merely adding unrelated ports.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 A：高内存带宽支持数据传输，在共享内存中有效复用数据则可减少重复的全局内存访问。

learning.stemHtml: A simulation is bottlenecked by memory transfer speeds. Which GPU architectural feature addresses this?仿真受内存传输速度限制时，下列哪项 GPU 架构特性最有帮助？
learning.keyPointHtml:
选 A：高内存带宽支持数据传输，在共享内存中有效复用数据则可减少重复的全局内存访问。
Choose A: high memory bandwidth supports transfers, while useful reuse in shared memory can reduce repeated global-memory accesses.
learning.speedTipHtml:
高效搬运数据，并避免反复搬运同一份数据。
Move data efficiently and avoid moving the same data repeatedly.
studyNotesHtml:
先识别瓶颈链路：设备 DRAM、主机到设备的 PCIe，还是网络；片上共享内存不是所有传输路径的通用修复。
Identify which link is limiting: device DRAM, host-to-device PCIe or network. On-chip shared memory is not a universal fix for every transfer path.

测量有效带宽，定位受限的内存路径。
Measure effective bandwidth and locate the limiting memory path.

采用适当的合并访问与复用，而不是仅增加无关端口。
Use appropriate coalescing and reuse rather than merely adding unrelated ports.

options.explanation:

Best option: bandwidth helps transfer rate, and well-designed shared-memory reuse reduces redundant traffic. The kernel must actually exploit these features.

stem: Why use NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage in an AI cluster?
explanation:
选 C：受支持的存储设备可通过 DMA 向 GPU 内存传入或传出数据，避免通常的中间主机内存拷贝。
Choose C: a supported storage device can DMA data to or from GPU memory without the usual intermediate host-memory copy.

options.text: Increases GPU clock rate by offloading storage read/write.
options.translationZh: 卸载存储读写，从而提高 GPU 时钟频率。

options.text: Simplifies traditional CPU-centric storage input/output paths.
options.translationZh: 简化传统以 CPU 为中心的存储 I/O 路径。

options.text: Enables peer-to-peer memory transfers between GPUs and NVMe storage.
options.translationZh: 支持 GPU 内存与 NVMe 存储之间的对等数据传输。

options.text: Improves TCP/IP data transmission speeds between GPUs and CPUs.
options.translationZh: 提高 GPU 与 CPU 之间的 TCP/IP 数据传输速度。

reason.en: Broadly related, but less precise: simpler CPU-centric I/O is not the defining mechanism. The specific benefit is the supported direct storage/GPU path in C.
reason.zh: 广义上相关但不够精确：简化 CPU 中心 I/O 不是定义性机制；具体收益是 C 中受支持的存储与 GPU 直接路径。

C.zh: 支持 GPU 内存与 NVMe 存储之间的对等数据传输。

reason.en: Best answer for a supported NVMe configuration: direct DMA can avoid host bounce buffering. It does not imply every device/filesystem supports this path.
reason.zh: 对于受支持 NVMe 配置是最佳答案：直接 DMA 可避免主机中转缓冲；不意味着所有设备／文件系统都支持该路径。

D.zh: 提高 GPU 与 CPU 之间的 TCP/IP 数据传输速度。

reason.en: Wrong target: GDS addresses file-storage transfers to GPU memory, not a general TCP/IP accelerator for communication between CPU and GPU.
reason.zh: 目标不符：GDS 处理文件存储到 GPU 内存的传输，不是 CPU 与 GPU 通信的通用 TCP/IP 加速器。

stem: Why is Slurm widely adopted as a workload manager in AI and HPC clusters?
explanation:
选 B：策略驱动的队列与资源分配，使管理员能够协调异构计算作业及其优先级。
Choose B: policy-driven queues and resource allocation let administrators coordinate heterogeneous compute jobs and priorities.

options.text: It continuously monitors facility-level power infrastructure and automatically reconfigures data center electrical distribution during peak demand.
options.translationZh: 持续监控设施电力，并在高峰时自动重构数据中心配电。

options.text: It provides robust, policy-driven job scheduling with support for queues, priorities, reservations, and fine-grained resource allocation for heterogeneous nodes.
options.translationZh: 提供基于策略的作业调度，支持队列、优先级、预留与异构节点的细粒度资源分配。

options.text: It dynamically overclocks GPUs and other accelerators to maximize FLOPS without requiring changes to application code.
options.translationZh: 动态超频 GPU 等加速器，无需改动应用代码即可最大化算力。

options.text: It is the only platform that can launch and manage containerized workloads across GPU-accelerated nodes in a production environment.
options.translationZh: 它是唯一能在生产 GPU 节点上启动与管理容器化工作负载的平台。

stem: In a 512-GPU training cluster, engineers observe poor scaling efficiency when moving from single-node to multi-node runs, even though the compute nodes themselves are not fully utilized and the model code has already been optimized. Profiling shows that collective all-reduce operations dominate step time as node count increases. Why should InfiniBand be chosen over traditional Ethernet for this type of multi-node AI trainingenvironment?
explanation:
选 D：适当的 InfiniBand 网络可降低集合通信成本；兼容的网内聚合还可减少端点工作与流量。
Choose D: a suitable InfiniBand fabric reduces collective communication costs; compatible in-network aggregation can further reduce endpoint work and traffic.

options.text: It is significantly easier to deploy and maintain than any form of Ethernet and requires almost no specialized networking expertise.
options.translationZh: 比所有以太网都更易部署维护，几乎不需要专门网络知识。

options.text: It inherently guarantees end-to-end network security without the need for additional configuration or complementary security controls.
options.translationZh: 无需额外配置或其他控制，就天然保证端到端网络安全。

options.text: It always consumes less power than any alternative data center networking technology, regardless of topology or workload.
options.translationZh: 不论拓扑与负载，耗电始终低于其他数据中心网络技术。

options.text: It offers very high bandwidth, ultra-low latency, and hardware support for collective operations (for example, all-reduce) that improve distributed training scalability.
options.translationZh: 提供高带宽、低延迟，以及受支持配置下的全归约等集合操作硬件加速。

stem: In a large enterprise cluster, frequent out-of-memory errors occur mid-experiment. What operational feature resolves this?
explanation:

options.text: Resource reservation and usage monitoring in the workload manager.
options.translationZh: 工作负载管理器中的资源预留与用量监控。

options.text: Increase cluster node count automatically.
options.translationZh: 自动增加集群节点数量。

options.text: Deploy and monitor containers to boost GPU memory.

stem: What is the primary advantage for hybrid cloud/on-prem solutions in enterprise AI?
explanation:
选 D：混合部署可把指定数据或工作负载保留在本地控制下，同时在适合处使用云服务。
Choose D: hybrid placement can keep selected data or workloads under local control while using cloud services where appropriate.

options.text: No need for specialized hardware.
options.translationZh: 无需专用硬件。

options.text: Always highest performance for all workloads.
options.translationZh: 对所有工作负载始终提供最高性能。

options.text: Cheapest infrastructure costs for large scale.
options.translationZh: 大规模部署的基础设施成本最低。

options.text: Enhances data sovereignty and regulatory compliance.
options.translationZh: 有助于数据主权与监管合规要求的落实。

stem: What is a direct benefit of using GPUDirect RDMA for multi-server workloads?
explanation:
选 B：兼容网卡直接向 GPU 内存传入或传出数据，减少主机中转与 CPU 数据移动工作。
Choose B: a compatible network adapter moves data directly to or from GPU memory, reducing host staging and CPU data-movement work.

options.text: Raises GPU base memory clock speeds.
options.translationZh: 提高 GPU 基础显存时钟。

options.text: Offloads data movement from CPUs.
options.translationZh: 从 CPU 卸载数据移动工作。

options.text: Allows CPUs to prioritize scheduling.
options.translationZh: 让 CPU 优先处理调度。

options.text: Compresses transferred data.
options.translationZh: 压缩传输数据。

sources.title: GPUDirect RDMA guide
sources.supports: Supported PCIe peers exchange data directly with GPU memory, while drivers and CPU control establish the path.

outline:
区分传输工作、时钟速率与数据编码。
Separate transfer work from clock rates and data encoding.

选择直接卸载效果，而非节省 CPU 时间后可能发生的用途。
Choose the direct offload effect instead of a possible later use of saved CPU time.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 B：兼容网卡直接向 GPU 内存传入或传出数据，减少主机中转与 CPU 数据移动工作。
Choose B: a compatible network adapter moves data directly to or from GPU memory, reducing host staging and CPU data-movement work.

whyNotChoose.text: Raises GPU base memory clock speeds.
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：该技术改变传输路径与拷贝，而非物理显存时钟规格。
Incorrect: the technology changes the transfer route and copies, not the physical memory clock specification.

whyNotChoose.text: Allows CPUs to prioritize scheduling.
whyNotChoose.reason:
可能是间接效果，但不保证：释放的 CPU 容量可用于多种任务，GPUDirect 不决定这些任务的调度优先级。
Possible indirect effect, but not guaranteed: freed CPU capacity could serve many tasks, and GPUDirect does not dictate their scheduling priority.

whyNotChoose.text: Compresses transferred data.
whyNotChoose.reason:
不是固有功能：RDMA 传输与压缩是不同机制；需要压缩时，必须由另外的应用或加速器实现。
Not an inherent feature: RDMA transfer and compression are different mechanisms; a separate application or accelerator must implement compression if desired.

stem: NVIDIA AI Factories are designed primarily to support which part of the AI/MLOps pipeline?
explanation:
选 B：AI Factory 把数据处理、模型开发、部署与推理集成为可扩展的运行系统。
Choose B: an AI Factory integrates data processing, model development, deployment and inference into a scalable operational system.

options.text: Expansion of raw storage capacity without changing workflows.
options.translationZh: 只扩展原始存储容量，而不改变工作流。

options.text: Automated end-to-end handling of data, training, and deployment.
options.translationZh: 对数据、训练与部署进行端到端的自动化处理。

options.text: Long-term backup of unstructured data only.
options.translationZh: 只长期备份非结构化数据。

options.text: Manual test environment setup for GPU driver comparisons.
options.translationZh: 手动搭建用于比较 GPU 驱动的测试环境。

stem: What is the critical difference between Slurm and Kubernetes in AI infrastructure? (Choose two.)
explanation:
选 B、E：Slurm 侧重策略驱动的作业分配，Kubernetes 侧重容器工作负载与服务编排。
Choose B and E: Slurm emphasizes policy-driven job allocation, while Kubernetes emphasizes orchestration of container workloads and services.

options.text: Slurm provides full replacement for cluster-wide container orchestration, service discovery, and management of long-running microservices.
options.translationZh: Slurm 完全替代集群容器编排、服务发现与长期运行微服务管理。

options.text: Slurm schedules queued batch and HPC workloads onto available compute resources using job queues and policies.
options.translationZh: Slurm 通过作业队列与策略，把批处理和 HPC 工作负载分配到可用计算资源。

options.text: Both platforms are limited to basic job status monitoring for running workloads and provide no additional orchestration capabilities.
options.translationZh: 两个平台都仅限于基本作业状态监控，不提供其他编排能力。

options.text: Kubernetes focuses only on per-node resource allocation for individual batch jobs without managing distributed services or containers.
options.translationZh: Kubernetes 只为单个批处理作业分配单节点资源，不管理分布式服务或容器。

options.text: Kubernetes coordinates deployment, scaling, and lifecycle management of containerized services across nodes.
options.translationZh: Kubernetes 协调跨节点容器化服务的部署、扩缩容与生命周期。

sources.supports: Slurm schedules queued jobs and allocates cluster resources.

sources.supports: Kubernetes manages containerized workload deployment, scaling and service lifecycle.

outline:
识别各平台的主要抽象。
Identify each platform’s principal abstraction.

选出两项准确角色描述，排除“完全替代”或“仅限于”的说法。
Select both accurate role descriptions and reject full-replacement or only claims.

whyNotChoose.text: Slurm provides full replacement for cluster-wide container orchestration, service discovery, and management of long-running microservices.
whyNotChoose.reason:
夸大了可互换性：启动容器作业，不会使 Slurm 完全替代 Kubernetes 的服务抽象与控制器。
Overstates interchangeability: launching container jobs does not make Slurm a full replacement for Kubernetes service abstractions and controllers.

whyNotChoose.text: Both platforms are limited to basic job status monitoring for running workloads and provide no additional orchestration capabilities.
whyNotChoose.reason:
错误：两者都主动管理执行与资源，监控只是功能的一部分。
False: both actively manage execution and resources; monitoring is only one part of their functionality.

whyNotChoose.text: Kubernetes focuses only on per-node resource allocation for individual batch jobs without managing distributed services or containers.
whyNotChoose.reason:
与其核心角色矛盾：Kubernetes 跨节点管理容器工作负载与服务，其中包括但不限于批处理作业。
Contradicts its core role: Kubernetes manages container workloads and services across nodes, including but not limited to batch jobs.

learning.stemHtml: What is the critical difference between Slurm and Kubernetes in AI infrastructure? (Choose two.)Slurm 与 Kubernetes 在 AI 基础设施中的主要角色差异是什么？（选择两项。）

Choose B and E: Slurm emphasizes policy-driven job allocation, while Kubernetes emphasizes orchestration of container workloads and services.
learning.speedTipHtml:
Slurm：排队作业；Kubernetes：容器与服务的期望状态。
Slurm: queued jobs. Kubernetes: desired container/service state.
studyNotesHtml:
这些角色存在交集：Kubernetes 能运行批处理，Slurm 能启动容器；二者都不限于状态监控。
These roles overlap: Kubernetes can run batch workloads, and Slurm can launch containers. Neither is limited to status monitoring.

stem: Which protocol is most critical for low-latency GPU-to-GPU transfers in large AI clusters using Ethernet?
explanation:
C 是预期的 NVIDIA 以太网 RDMA 选择：RoCE。iWARP 同样是 RDMA 技术，因此答案取决于部署生态，不仅是是否使用以太网。
C is the intended NVIDIA Ethernet RDMA choice: RoCE. iWARP is also an RDMA technology, so the answer depends on the deployment ecosystem rather than Ethernet alone.

options.text: DCTCP with ECN-based congestion control.
options.translationZh: 采用 ECN 拥塞控制的 DCTCP。

options.text: PFC-only lossless Ethernet without RDMA.
options.translationZh: 仅使用 PFC 的无丢包以太网，不使用 RDMA。

options.text: RDMA over Converged Ethernet (RoCE).
options.translationZh: 融合以太网上的 RDMA（RoCE）。

options.text: iWARP (RDMA on TCP over Ethernet).
options.translationZh: iWARP，在以太网 TCP 上实现 RDMA。

sources.supports: Documents InfiniBand and RoCE as supported fabric choices.

sources.title: RFC 5040: RDMAP
sources.supports: RDMAP can run over DDP/MPA/TCP, showing TCP-based RDMA is real.

sources.title: Cisco AI/ML networking blueprint
sources.supports: ECN and PFC handle congestion and loss control; they do not by themselves implement RDMA.

sources.title: GPUDirect RDMA guide
sources.supports: Supported PCIe peers exchange data directly with GPU memory, while drivers and CPU control establish the path.

outline:
区分拥塞／流量控制与远程内存语义。
Separate congestion/flow control from remote-memory semantics.

把协议与文档所述 NVIDIA 适配器／软件生态匹配。
Match the protocol to the documented NVIDIA adapter/software ecosystem.
analysis.whyChoose:
C 是预期的 NVIDIA 以太网 RDMA 选择：RoCE。iWARP 同样是 RDMA 技术，因此答案取决于部署生态，不仅是是否使用以太网。
C is the intended NVIDIA Ethernet RDMA choice: RoCE. iWARP is also an RDMA technology, so the answer depends on the deployment ecosystem rather than Ethernet alone.

whyNotChoose.text: DCTCP with ECN-based congestion control.
whyNotChoose.reason:
不是 RDMA 机制：DCTCP 改变 TCP 拥塞行为，本身不建立远程 GPU 内存直接访问。
Not the RDMA mechanism: DCTCP changes TCP congestion behavior, but does not itself establish direct remote GPU-memory access.

whyNotChoose.text: PFC-only lossless Ethernet without RDMA.
whyNotChoose.reason:
按定义不充分：流量控制的暂停行为不提供 RDMA 内存注册、放置与传输操作。
Insufficient by definition: flow-control pause behavior does not provide RDMA memory registration, placement and transfer operations.

whyNotChoose.text: iWARP (RDMA on TCP over Ethernet).
whyNotChoose.reason:
确实是另一种 RDMA 栈，并非本质无效；它不是引用的 NVIDIA 部署所选 RoCE 栈，原题泛化表述的条件不足。
A genuine alternative RDMA stack, not intrinsically invalid. It is not the RoCE stack selected by this referenced NVIDIA deployment; the original generic wording is underspecified.

summary.zh: C 是预期的 NVIDIA 以太网 RDMA 选择：RoCE。iWARP 同样是 RDMA 技术，因此答案取决于部署生态，不仅是是否使用以太网。

memory.en: PFC/ECN control traffic; RoCE provides RDMA; compatibility enables GPU direct paths.
memory.zh: PFC／ECN 控制流量；RoCE 提供 RDMA；兼容集成启用 GPU 直接路径。

pitfall.en: Do not call iWARP ordinary TCP copying. It implements RDMA over TCP. Choosing RoCE here is not evidence of universal protocol superiority.
pitfall.zh: 不要把 iWARP 说成普通 TCP 拷贝，它在 TCP 上实现 RDMA。这里选择 RoCE 不证明协议普遍优越。

steps.en: Separate congestion/flow control from remote-memory semantics.
steps.zh: 区分拥塞／流量控制与远程内存语义。

steps.en: Match the protocol to the documented NVIDIA adapter/software ecosystem.
steps.zh: 把协议与文档所述 NVIDIA 适配器／软件生态匹配。

terms.zh: 基于 TCP 的 RDMA 技术

A.zh: 采用 ECN 拥塞控制的 DCTCP。

reason.en: Not the RDMA mechanism: DCTCP changes TCP congestion behavior, but does not itself establish direct remote GPU-memory access.
reason.zh: 不是 RDMA 机制：DCTCP 改变 TCP 拥塞行为，本身不建立远程 GPU 内存直接访问。

B.zh: 仅使用 PFC 的无丢包以太网，不使用 RDMA。

reason.en: Insufficient by definition: flow-control pause behavior does not provide RDMA memory registration, placement and transfer operations.
reason.zh: 按定义不充分：流量控制的暂停行为不提供 RDMA 内存注册、放置与传输操作。

C.zh: 融合以太网上的 RDMA（RoCE）。

reason.en: Best intended answer for the documented NVIDIA Ethernet deployment. Actual low-latency GPU transfers require compatible hardware, software and fabric tuning.
reason.zh: 对于文档所述 NVIDIA 以太网部署是预期最佳答案；实际低延迟 GPU 传输仍需兼容硬件、软件与网络调优。

D.zh: iWARP，在以太网 TCP 上实现 RDMA。

reason.en: A genuine alternative RDMA stack, not intrinsically invalid. It is not the RoCE stack selected by this referenced NVIDIA deployment; the original generic wording is underspecified.
reason.zh: 确实是另一种 RDMA 栈，并非本质无效；它不是引用的 NVIDIA 部署所选 RoCE 栈，原题泛化表述的条件不足。

stem: What is a key advantage of dynamic, priority-based job scheduling in an AI cluster?
explanation:
选 C：资源竞争时，优先级可让紧急工作优先获得资源，但受资格、可用容量与抢占策略约束。
Choose C: priorities can favor urgent work when resources are contested, subject to eligibility, available capacity and preemption policy.

options.text: It operates completely independently of job priority, user role, or service-level objectives defined for different workloads.
options.translationZh: 完全独立于作业优先级、用户角色与服务目标运行。

options.text: It is designed primarily for lightly utilized or idle clusters, where there is little or no contention for resources.
options.translationZh: 主要面向几乎没有资源争用的轻载或空闲集群。

options.text: It ensures time-critical or high-priority workloads receive prompt access to constrained compute resources when contention occurs.
options.translationZh: 资源竞争时，让时间敏感或高优先级工作负载更及时地获得计算资源。

options.text: It allocates identical resource shares to every submitted job, regardless of workload type or business impact.
options.translationZh: 不论工作负载类型或业务影响，都给所有作业相同资源份额。

stem: What distinguishes an edge AI deployment from cloud-based deployments?
explanation:
选 B：边缘 AI 在靠近数据来源处处理数据，例如摄像头、工厂设备或本地网关。
Choose B: edge AI processes data near its source, such as a camera, factory device or local gateway.

options.text: Eliminates need for network management.
options.translationZh: 不再需要网络管理。

options.text: Processes data close to the source.
options.translationZh: 在靠近数据来源的位置处理数据。

options.text: Relies solely on CPU for all computation.
options.translationZh: 全部计算只能依赖 CPU。

options.text: Requires higher-capacity GPUs at every site.
options.translationZh: 每个站点都必须配备更大容量 GPU。

sources.supports: AI processing occurs near users and data sources rather than solely in a central cloud facility.

outline:
确定计算位置相对数据产生设备的距离。

stem: Which of the following is a best practice for addressing model drift in AI operations?
explanation:
选 B：监控生产数据与预测质量，调查有意义的变化，并在需要时利用验证过的当前数据重训或修正流程。
Choose B: monitor production data and prediction quality, investigate meaningful changes, and retrain or correct the pipeline with validated current data when needed.

options.text: Increase hardware resources when accuracy drops.
options.translationZh: 准确率下降时增加硬件资源。

options.text: Monitor deployed models regularly and retrain with fresh data.
options.translationZh: 定期监控已部署模型，并在需要时使用新数据重新训练。

options.text: Permit changes in input data distributions over time.
options.translationZh: 允许输入数据分布随时间变化。

options.text: Allow the model to generalize to any data.
options.translationZh: 让模型泛化到任何数据。

sources.title: AWS: production model monitoring
sources.supports: Monitoring deviations supports diagnosis, retraining and upstream data-quality corrections; cited for the monitoring pattern, not a new-service recommendation.

sources.title: AWS: model quality monitoring
sources.supports: Prediction quality can be evaluated by joining predictions with ground-truth labels and comparing to a baseline.

outline:
相对基线跟踪数据特征与相关模型表现。
Track data characteristics and relevant model performance against a baseline.

调查数据缺陷或关系变化，再验证所选修复。
Investigate data defects or changed relationships, then validate the chosen remedy.
analysis.whyChoose:
选 B：监控生产数据与预测质量，调查有意义的变化，并在需要时利用验证过的当前数据重训或修正流程。
Choose B: monitor production data and prediction quality, investigate meaningful changes, and retrain or correct the pipeline with validated current data when needed.

whyNotChoose.text: Increase hardware resources when accuracy drops.
whyNotChoose.reason:
不能修复变化的统计关系：更多算力可能降低延迟，但不会自行更新模型学到的行为。
Does not fix changed statistical relationships: more compute may reduce latency, but does not by itself update a model’s learned behavior.

whyNotChoose.text: Permit changes in input data distributions over time.
whyNotChoose.reason:
这是条件描述而非修复措施：真实输入可能变化，但仅允许变化不能检测或缓解预测退化。
Describes a condition rather than a remedy. Real inputs can change, but simply permitting that change does not detect or mitigate degraded predictions.

whyNotChoose.text: Allow the model to generalize to any data.
whyNotChoose.reason:
不是可实现的运维保证：没有模型能保证不受限制、不需监控或更新就处理任意未来数据。
Not an operationally achievable guarantee: no model is assured to handle arbitrary future data without limits, monitoring or updates.

originalExplanation: Model drift happens when real-world data changes over time, reducing model accuracy. The best practice is to monitor model performance continuously and retrain or update the model using current, representative data.

aiStudy.stemZh: AI 运维中，处理模型漂移的一项合理实践是什么？

sources.title: AWS: production model monitoring
sources.supports: Monitoring deviations supports diagnosis, retraining and upstream data-quality corrections; cited for the monitoring pattern, not a new-service recommendation.

sources.title: AWS: model quality monitoring
sources.supports: Prediction quality can be evaluated by joining predictions with ground-truth labels and comparing to a baseline.

aiStudy.reviewNote: Retained B with diagnosis and validation. Input-distribution drift and predictive/concept drift differ; not every shift harms accuracy, and new data alone does not justify blind automatic retraining.

summary.en: Choose B: monitor production data and prediction quality, investigate meaningful changes, and retrain or correct the pipeline with validated current data when needed.
summary.zh: 选 B：监控生产数据与预测质量，调查有意义的变化，并在需要时利用验证过的当前数据重训或修正流程。

memory.en: Monitor → diagnose → update if needed → evaluate before release.
memory.zh: 监控 → 诊断 → 按需更新 → 发布前评估。

pitfall.en: A changed input distribution is not proof of worse predictions. Use quality metrics and ground truth when available, and compare any replacement model before deployment.
pitfall.zh: 输入分布改变不证明预测变差。应在可行时使用质量指标与真实标签，并在部署前比较替代模型。

steps.en: Track data characteristics and relevant model performance against a baseline.
steps.zh: 相对基线跟踪数据特征与相关模型表现。

steps.en: Investigate data defects or changed relationships, then validate the chosen remedy.
steps.zh: 调查数据缺陷或关系变化，再验证所选修复。
